title: Technical Program Manager with verification
description:
About the job

Technical Program Manager




Turn complex implementations into successful customer outcomes

This isn’t a role where you simply track timelines or coordinate meetings.




At Bidgely, Technical Program Managers sit at the intersection of customer success, engineering, product, and delivery. When a utility asks, “How will this actually work for us?” You’re the person who turns complexity into a clear, executable plan and delivers it.




You’ll own the successful implementation of Bidgely’s platform for utilities across Europe and the Middle East, guiding customers from onboarding through launch while working directly with engineering teams on integrations, architecture, and delivery.




If you enjoy turning complex technical deployments into real-world outcomes for customers, this role will feel energizing.




Why This Role Exists

Utilities around the world are rapidly modernizing their infrastructure as EV adoption, distributed solar, batteries, and smart devices reshape the grid.




Bidgely helps utilities navigate that transformation through AI-powered energy insights and customer engagement platforms.




As demand for our platform grows internationally, we need experienced Technical Program Managers who can confidently guide utilities through complex implementations, aligning stakeholders, solving technical challenges, and ensuring customers see real value from the platform.




Your mission over the next 6–12 months is simple:

Deliver successful customer implementations that turn powerful technology into measurable outcomes for utilities.




How You’ll Make an Impact

You’ll own the delivery and technical implementation of Bidgely’s platform for enterprise utility customers.




In practice, that means you will:

Lead customer implementations end-to-end




Own enterprise deployments from onboarding through launch, ensuring projects stay on track and deliver measurable customer value.




Translate customer needs into technical solutions

Work directly with customer engineering teams to design integrations, define data flows, and implement scalable solutions using Bidgely’s platform.




Drive alignment across teams

Coordinate closely with product, engineering, delivery, and sales teams to move projects forward and resolve challenges quickly.




Turn complexity into clarity for customers

Serve as the primary point of contact during implementation, helping customers understand the platform and confidently move through deployment.




Identify opportunities beyond launch

Ensure customers achieve their goals post-deployment and help uncover opportunities for deeper platform adoption.




What Success Looks Like

At 3 months

You’re confidently managing customer implementations, running project meetings, and collaborating with engineering teams on integration planning.

You understand Bidgely’s platform architecture and can clearly translate customer requirements into implementation plans.




At 12 months

You’ve successfully delivered multiple enterprise deployments across Europe.

Customers view you as a trusted advisor who can navigate technical complexity and keep projects moving.

Your work directly contributes to successful launches, satisfied customers, and expansion opportunities.




What Makes Someone Successful Here

Ownership.




The strongest TPMs here don’t just manage timelines. They own outcomes.

They ask questions early, surface risks quickly, and collaborate across teams to keep complex implementations moving forward.




Strong Technical Program Managers at Bidgely:

Connect technical details to business outcomes
Stay calm when implementations get messy
Ask the right questions before proposing solutions
Communicate clearly with both engineers and executives
Take pride in delivering high-quality customer experiences




What You’ll Do

Program Leadership & Customer Delivery

Own the successful delivery of enterprise customer implementations from onboarding through launch
Serve as the primary customer-facing lead during implementation
Manage project timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables
Facilitate project meetings, engineering standups, and stakeholder updates
Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Delivery, Sales, and Support teams
Contribute to contract reviews and change orders when implementation scope evolves
Represent the onboarding team in customer presentations and sales engagements as needed




Technical Leadership

Lead solution design and implementation for enterprise utility customers
Work directly with customer engineering teams on data integrations, APIs, and system architecture
Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions
Guide requirement analysis, integration planning, and implementation execution
Identify product gaps and collaborate with Product teams on enhancements
Produce technical documentation outlining architecture, integrations, and deployment plans
Partner with engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues




Customer Success & Market Impact

Develop deep expertise in the utility and energy markets
Ensure customers achieve measurable value from the platform
Identify opportunities for future growth within customer accounts
Travel to customer sites up to 50% of the time, primarily across Europe
Occasionally travel to Bidgely headquarters in Los Altos, CA




What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Fluent in Italian (written and spoken) with the ability to discuss technical topics
5–7 years managing software implementation or integration programs at a technology company
Experience delivering complex enterprise implementations for high-touch customers
Proven experience serving as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers
Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams and offshore engineering resources
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Strong experience designing and delivering cloud-based B2B implementations
Ability to manage project plans, risks, and deliverables using tools such as Jira, Smartsheets, or similar platforms
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong time management and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects
Customer-first mindset and strong relationship-building skills




Based on the U.S. East Coast




Comfortable working 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM EST to collaborate with international teams




Ability to travel internationally up to 50%, primarily to Europe with occasional multi-week stays. (No history of being denied entry to other countries)




Preferred Qualifications

Experience working at a SaaS startup or high-growth technology company
Experience implementing SaaS platforms for enterprise customers
Background in systems integration consulting
Familiarity with SQL, Python, REST APIs, or data transformation technologies
Experience in the energy, utilities, or energy efficiency sector
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification




About Bidgely

Bidgely is an AI-powered SaaS company helping utilities modernize the grid and improve customer outcomes through advanced analytics.

Founded in Silicon Valley, Bidgely holds more than 17 energy patents and serves utilities supporting over 27 million customers globally.

We operate at the intersection of AI, energy, and infrastructure, helping utilities build a smarter and more resilient energy future.




The Logistics

Location: Remote within the U.S. (East Coast)

Travel: Up to 50% international travel, primarily to Europe

Compensation: $100,000 – $135,000 base salary

title: Partner Solutions Engineer with verification
description:
About the job

Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including Built In's 100 Best Midsize Places to Work in SF 2025, Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025, Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023, #4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ ,Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list, and Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List.

Front is looking for a Partner Solutions Engineer to join a world-class Solutions & Services organization.

As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you’ll develop deep technical product expertise and play a critical role in enabling and scaling Front through our partner ecosystem. You will define, design, and implement creative product solutions that expand the reach of Front’s platform across partners and their customers, connecting Front with 3rd party applications and systems.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor to partners, working closely with Channel Account Managers. This role involves collaborating cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive successful joint outcomes.

What will you be doing?

Partner enablement & ecosystem development


Build strong relationships with partner pre-sales, delivery, and technical teams
Enable partners to confidently position, demo, and implement Front
Deliver partner trainings, workshops, and technical certifications
Act as the primary technical point of contact for channel partners


Joint selling & deal support


Partner with Channel Account Managers and Account Executives on partner-led and co-sell opportunities
Support partners in engaging prospects and customers to maximize value and close new business
Join partner-led calls to provide technical validation and solution design


Solution design & demos


Work with partners and customers to understand and validate technical requirements
Customize and deliver partner-enabled product demonstrations tailored to specific use cases
Guide partners in building compelling technical narratives and ROI articulation


Integrations & technical expertise


Develop deep expertise in Front’s APIs and integration ecosystem
Help partners design scalable solutions integrating Front with third-party systems
Provide architectural guidance and best practices


What skills and experience do you need?


4–7 years of experience in solutions engineering, architecture, or partner/customer-facing roles in SaaS
Experience working with channel partners, resellers, or system integrators
Proven success supporting co-sell or partner-led sales motions
Strong understanding of software design principles and integrations
Experience with APIs and building solutions across multiple systems
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience with AI-powered features and ability to explain their value and limitations
Strong collaboration skills across internal teams and external stakeholders
Willingness and flexibility to travel for conferences and partner events as needed


What We Offer


Competitive salary
Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
Paid parental leave
Flexible time off policy
Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
Mental health support with Workplace Options
Family planning support with Maven
$100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
Wellness Days - Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
Winter Break - Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!


Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the California Recruiting Privacy Notice  & EU Privacy Notice

title: Program Manager with verification
description:
About the job

Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

Job Title

Program Manager –

Role Overview

The Engagement Lead / Technical Program Manager (TPM) is accountable for the successful orchestration of client transformation engagement across multiple workstreams and scenarios.

This role owns program governance, execution discipline, cross-pod coordination, financial management, and stakeholder alignment. While the Account Technical Lead owns architectural integrity, the Engagement Lead ensures delivery integrity.

The TPM operates at the intersection of product, engineering, architecture, compliance, and executive leadership — driving clarity, momentum, and accountability across a complex, phased program

Core Responsibilities


 End-to-End Program Leadership
Lead the integrated transformation program across:
Portal migration and modernization
CRM selection and implementation
Data & insights capability development
Enterprise integration and SaaS enablement
Establish and maintain the integrated master roadmap.
Sequence initiatives across Stabilize → Modernize → Optimize phases.
Identify and proactively manage cross-domain dependencies.
 Governance & Executive Alignment
Design and operate the client governance model.
Facilitate executive steering committee meetings and decision forums.
Maintain transparent program reporting (status, risks, financials, dependencies).
Ensure decisions are documented and tied to business outcomes.
Escalate risks early with clear mitigation paths.
 Delivery Management Across Agile Pods
Oversee multiple agile product pods (Portal, CRM, Data, Integration).
Ensure backlog alignment to strategic outcomes and quarterly priorities.
Coordinate cross-pod release planning.
Monitor sprint health, velocity, and delivery predictability.
Balance agility with enterprise-level discipline.
 Financial & Commercial Oversight
Own program financial tracking (budget vs. actuals).
Forecast capacity needs and resource allocation.
Manage commercial adherence to phased engagement model.
Protect margin while preserving client trust and long-term value.
 Risk & Compliance Coordination
Maintain integrated program risk register.
Ensure compliance-related activities (SOC 2 continuity, audit readiness, security reviews) are tracked and sequenced.
Align technical execution with governance requirements.
Partner closely with the Account Technical Lead on architectural risk impacts.
 Stakeholder & Change Enablement
Act as primary day-to-day executive liaison for program execution.
Maintain alignment across product, IT, compliance, and business leaders.
Drive structured change management alongside technical rollout.
Ensure adoption, enablement, and transition plans are built into delivery — not deferred.
 Capability Transition & Ownership
Plan progressive transition of ownership to client teams.
Ensure documentation, runbooks, and operational readiness artifacts are delivered.
Support evolution toward client’s product-led operating model.
Reduce long-term dependency while maintaining partnership continuity.



Required Experience

Program Leadership Profile


12–15+ years in program leadership, technical program management, or large-scale transformation roles.
Demonstrated leadership of multi-workstream enterprise programs.
Experience operating in regulated or trust-sensitive industries (financial services, fintech, wealth management, philanthropy, or similar).
Proven ability to manage both technical and business stakeholders.



Delivery & Technical Fluency

The ideal candidate must be technically literate (though not necessarily hands-on):


Cloud-native environments (Azure and/or AWS).
API-first and integration-heavy ecosystems.
CRM implementations (Salesforce or equivalent).
Data platform modernization initiatives.
DevSecOps and CI/CD environments.
Experience working alongside enterprise architects and engineering leads.



Leadership Characteristics


Executive presence and calm under ambiguity.
Structured communicator with high documentation discipline.
Strong commercial acumen.
Decisive, yet collaborative.
Able to manage tension between speed, cost, and risk.
Transparent, low-ego, partnership-oriented.



What Success Looks Like (12–24 Months)


Program delivered in phased increments without major architectural or compliance rework.
Strong executive confidence in roadmap clarity and risk management.
Predictable release cadence across portal, CRM, and data initiatives.
Clear financial transparency and margin control.
Documented governance rhythm embedded inside client.
Progressive ownership transition to client teams.



Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidate Privacy Policy

Orion Systems Integrators, LLC And Its Subsidiaries And Its Affiliates (collectively, “Orion,” “we” Or “us”) Are Committed To Protecting Your Privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) (“Notice”) Explains


What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;
How we handle that information; and
How to access and update that information.



Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Affinity is the relationship intelligence CRM trusted by private equity, venture capital, and investment banking professionals to manage their most valuable asset: relationships. Our platform transforms how deal teams source opportunities, manage pipelines, and accelerate deal flow by automatically capturing and organizing relationship data. With our 72-hour implementation and AI-powered insights, we're redefining what's possible in private capital markets.

## **The Role**

Affinity is the relationship intelligence platform built for the way private equity, venture capital, and growth equity firms actually work. Our customers don't just need a CRM, they need a system that understands their network, surfaces the right relationships at the right time, and turns proprietary deal flow into a competitive advantage.

As a Solutions Engineer, you sit at the center of that story. You're the person who makes the complex feel simple by translating Affinity's platform capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for PE and VC deal teams, while ensuring every proof of concept, integration, and technical conversation moves a deal forward.

You'll report to the Manager of Solutions Engineering and work closely with AEs, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. SEs act as the connective tissue across the go-to-market organization.

## **What You'll Do**

### **Technical Pre-Sales**

*   Own the technical sales motion for Growth, Mid-Market, and Strategic opportunities from first demo to signed contract.
*   Deliver differentiated, persona-driven demos for PE/VC deal teams that connect Affinity's capabilities to how they source, manage, and close deals.
*   Lead discovery conversations to uncover technical requirements, integration needs, and security considerations early in the sales cycle.
*   Respond to RFPs and RFIs with crisp, accurate, and compelling content that reflects our platform's true strengths.
*   Partner with AEs to shape deal strategy, influence qualification, and accelerate technical win decisions.
*   Handle technical objections with confidence, using a command of our product, integrations, and competitive positioning.

### **Proof of Value (POV) Execution**

*   Design and lead structured POV engagements that demonstrate measurable business impact.
*   Define success criteria upfront with champions and economic buyers; hold both sides accountable throughout.
*   Collaborate with Professional Services on complex integration scoping and implementation planning.
*   Maintain clear project momentum using Mutual Action Plans (MAPs) and consistent stakeholder communication.
*   Use POV outcomes to build references, case studies, and repeatable playbooks for the broader SE team.

### **Information Security & Data Privacy**

*   Serve as the security expert for pre-sales by completing InfoSec questionnaires, navigating compliance conversations, and representing our Trust posture with confidence.
*   Engage with C-level technical stakeholders on system architecture, data privacy, SSO/IDP configurations, and security policies.
*   Translate complex security requirements into clear responses that build buyer trust without stalling deals.

### **SE Team Contributions**

*   Contribute to and improve team-wide SE assets: demo scripts, battlecards, integration guides, and objection-handling frameworks.
*   Share deal insights, product gaps, and competitive intelligence that feed back into product roadmap and GTM strategy.
*   Help raise the bar across the team.

## **What You Bring**

### **Required**

*   Familiarity with private equity, venture capital, or financial services with a clear understanding of how deal teams operate and what they care about.
*   1+ years in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or technical pre-sales role ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
*   A track record of owning the technical sales motion: demos, POCs, RFPs, and security reviews.
*   Fluency in SSO and IDP technologies (SAML, OAuth, SCIM).
*   Experience navigating InfoSec questionnaires and compliance conversations in enterprise sales cycles.
*   Exceptional communication skills. You can command a room with a CFO or dig into API architecture with a developer.
*   Strong discovery instincts and comfort with value-based selling frameworks (Command of the Message, MEDDIC or similar).
*   A degree in Computer Science, finance, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Nice to Have**

*   Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations. You can read API docs, scope integrations, and speak fluently with technical buyers.
*   Salesforce Admin certification or meaningful hands-on SFDC experience.
*   A background in security, compliance, or data privacy.
*   Experience working with or demoing relationship intelligence, CRM, or data enrichment platforms.

## **What you'll enjoy at Affinity**

*   We live our values as playmakers who are obsessed with learning, care personally about our colleagues and clients, are radically open-minded, and take pride in everything we do.
*   We pay your medical, dental, and vision insurance with comprehensive PPO and HMO plans. And provide flexible personal & sick days. We want our team to be happy and healthy :)
*   We offer a 401k plan to help you plan for retirement.
*   We provide an annual budget for you to spend on education and offer a comprehensive L&D program – after all, one of our core values is that we're #obsessedwithlearning!
*   We support our employee's overall health and well-being and reimburse monthly for things such as; Transportation, Home Internet, Meals, and Wellness memberships/equipment.
*   Virtual team building and socials. Keeping people connected is essential.

**About Affinity**

With more than 3,000 customers worldwide and backed by some of Silicon Valley's best firms, Affinity has raised $120M to empower dealmakers to find, manage, and close more deals. How? Our Relationship Intelligence platform uses the wealth of data exhaust from trillions of interactions between Investment Bankers, Venture Capitalists, Consultants, and other strategic dealmakers to deliver automated relationship insights that drive over 450,000 deals every month. We are are proud to have received Inc. and Fortune Best Workplaces awards as well as to be Great Places to Work certified for the last 5 years running. Join us on our mission to make it possible for anyone to cultivate and fully harness their network to succeed.

**We use E-Verify**

Our company uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify.

title: Talent Development Program Manager
description:
About the job

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use Customer.io to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Our platform powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

But building great software starts with building great teams. At Customer.io, we’re investing intentionally in how our people grow—accelerating leadership capability and helping employees build the skills they need to thrive in a rapidly evolving, AI-enabled world.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Talent Development Program Manager to help us build and scale the programs that make this possible. This is not a traditional L&D role focused on maintaining existing training. This is a builder role. You’ll partner closely with the Director of Learning, Growth, and Development to design and launch high-impact programs while getting to own execution, facilitation, and continuous improvement.

You’ll play a foundational role in shaping how skill development and career growth evolve at Customer.io—and help create programs that enable our people to do the best work of their careers.

What You’ll Do


Help Build the Future of Talent Development at Customer.io: Partner closely with the Director of Learning, Growth, and Development to design and scale programs that strengthen manager capability and support employee growth at every level. Contribute ideas that help shape our long-term talent development strategy.
Own and Execute High-Impact Programs End-to-End: Lead the execution of development programs from concept through delivery and iteration. Manage timelines, communications, logistics, and stakeholder coordination while ensuring an exceptional participant experience in a fully remote environment.
Facilitate Meaningful, Engaging Learning Experiences: Facilitate live workshops, cohort programs, and development sessions that are practical, engaging, and immediately applicable. Create learning environments where employees can reflect, practice new skills, and grow with confidence.
Support Critical Capability-Building Initiatives: Help design and run programs such as mentorship programs, AI capability training, and skill academies that strengthen the organization’s ability to adapt, lead, and innovate.
Translate Organizational Needs into Effective Programs: Partner with teams to help turn performance insights and evolving business needs into thoughtful development initiatives that improve team effectiveness and employee growth.
Continuously Improve and Scale What Works: Evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities for improvement, and help evolve our development programs as Customer.io continues to grow and scale.



What We’re Looking For


Experienced Talent Development or Program Management Professional: 4–7+ years of experience in talent development, learning and development, leadership development, program management, or a related field.
Exceptional Facilitator and Learning Experience Designer: You have experience facilitating engaging learning experiences and know how to create environments where people feel comfortable learning, reflecting, and growing. You can translate complex ideas into clear, practical guidance.
Strong Program Builder and Executor: You’ve helped build or scale programs or initiatives and can independently manage execution from planning through delivery. You bring structure, follow-through, and attention to detail while staying focused on outcomes.
Strategic Thinker with Strong Curiosity: You naturally think beyond program logistics and are curious about how learning connects to organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and business impact.
Clear Communicator and Trusted Partner: You communicate clearly, build trust quickly, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across teams and levels.
Ownership Mindset and Builder Mentality: You’re energized by the opportunity to help build programs from early stages and improve them over time. You take initiative, operate independently, and are motivated by meaningful, high-impact work.



Bonus points for:


Experience building mentorship or career development programs
Experience leading AI capabilities training
Experience facilitating manager or leadership development programs
Experience working in remote-first or distributed organizations
Familiarity with modern learning tools or AI-enabled learning environments



Why this role is unique

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of talent development at Customer.io during a period of meaningful investment and growth. You’ll work directly with the Director of Learning, Growth, and Development to build programs that strengthen org-wide capability, accelerate career growth, and help employees develop future-ready skills. Your work will directly influence how managers lead, how employees grow, and how the organization scales.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is $95,000–$105,000 USD annually (or equivalent in local currency), depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including: 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. 16 weeks paid parental leave. Unlimited PTO. Remote work and wellness stipends. Professional development budget. And more! See full benefits here.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions—just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.


30-minute phone call with Recruiter
45-minute video call with Hiring Manager
30-minute behavioral interviews with 3 cross-functional partners
Take-home assignment - develop short live training for hiring panel
45-minute live training facilitated + discussion



All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verification.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We are committed to building an inclusive team culture, implementing equitable hiring practices, and expanding opportunities within the tech industry.

Join us

If you’re excited by the opportunity to help build programs that shape how people grow, lead, and succeed—and want to contribute to building a thoughtful, high-performing organization—we’d love to hear from you. Apply now.

title: Digital Marketing Solutions Engineer
description:
### **Description**

  
The Digital Marketing Solutions Engineer is responsible for maintaining and enabling the various digital platforms that support the marketing team’s content outreach activities, including websites, marketing automation, and social media accounts. This includes daily platform management, troubleshooting, coordinating content work with Marketing Managers, and interfacing with the various related vendors and support companies.  

They will be managing the Marketing Automation platform, scheduling and coordinating campaign activity with the rest of the Marketing team, including PPC advertising, LinkedIn Advertising, Social Media content posting and vendor-supplied monitoring services.  

In addition, they will collaborate with the Con Tech team to enable marketing automation workflows with the CRM system and manage leads generated by the Marketing Managers.  
  
The ideal candidate is a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative martech expert with experience in B2B industries, preferably construction, building materials, or related sectors. They will partner closely with internal teams and external agencies to deliver measurable growth in brand awareness, customer engagement, and qualified leads.

### **  
How You Will Help**

**  
Digital Strategy, Collaboration and Support**

*   Work with Marketing team stakeholders to develop and execute the company’s digital marketing strategies.
*   Facilitate scheduling and planning for content, websites, and marketing technology enhancements.
*   Identify and implement opportunities to improve digital performance, user experience, and operational efficiency.

**Content & Platform Management**

*   The Marketing Managers will be responsible for content development and work with this administrator to publish and promote it for web, mobile, email, and social channels—ensuring brand consistency, accuracy, and alignment with business priorities.
*   Manage website functionality, updates, UX improvements, and performance monitoring.
*   Manage integrations with other systems including CRM and E-Commerce platform managed by other teams
*   Coordinate online work with the marketing team, editorial calendars, product launch plans, and integrated digital campaigns across platforms.

**SEO / AI Search / Analytics**

*   Support SEO strategy including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and performance reporting.
*   Support emerging AI search visibility, structured data, and content optimization for new search behaviors.
*   Monitor analytics across platforms, providing insights and recommendations to improve traffic, engagement, and conversion.

**Social Media Management & Listening**

*   Serve as admin for corporate social media accounts and coordinate content updates
*   Work with outside resources to utilize social listening tools and processes to monitor conversations, identify trends, and protect brand reputation.
*   Track performance metrics, guide content optimization and audience targeting.

**Marketing Automation and Lead Management**

*   Collaborate with marketing managers to execute integrated digital campaigns that generate qualified leads.
*   Ensure CRM-facing data quality and alignment.
*   Support list segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign reporting.

**Agency & Vendor Management**

*   Collaborate with external digital agencies, creative partners, developers, and technical vendors.
*   Assist in evaluating new marketing technologies, tools, or partners.

### **  
What You Will Bring**

  

*   Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or related field.
*   5+ years of corporate marketing experience with a strong focus on digital channels.
*   Proven experience managing SEO, content, websites, social media, and digital campaigns.
*   Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
*   Excellent written and oral communication skills.
*   Experience collaborating across functions and influencing without direct authority.
*   Curiosity, openness to learning new technologies
*   Experience managing external agencies or freelance resources.
*   Familiarity and experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (We use MS Dynamics and HubSpot).
*   Experience in the construction, building materials, architecture, or industrial manufacturing industries.
*   Understanding of UX principles, analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console, etc.), and martech systems.
*   Knowledge of AI-driven search trends, structured data, and emerging digital technologies.
*   Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
*   Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed organization

### **  
About ASC Engineered Solutions**

Following the 2019 merger of Anvil International and Smith-Cooper International, the unified company relaunched in March 2021 as ASC Engineered Solutions. Under a single name and logo, ASC Engineered Solutions continues our focus on improving the customer experience every day and striving to deliver service excellence.  
  
The evolved ASC Engineered Solutions brand reinforces a focus on what matters most to customers: quality. As a solutions provider, this quality is reflected in our precision-engineered products, support and knowledge. Our organization is a dependable strategic partner focused on its customers’ success.

title: Senior Program Manager with verification
description:
About the job

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join our Marketing Applied Sciences team within General Motors’ Global Marketing Organization. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, data science, architecture, marketing stakeholders and external vendors to drive the successful delivery of complex marketing and advertising technology solutions.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone and execution support for a highly technical product area. You will ensure priorities are clearly defined, work is well-sequenced, dependencies are managed, and delivery is predictable and transparent. You will serve as scrum master, owning the operating rhythm across PI planning, sprint execution, backlog health, stakeholder communications, and vendor coordination.

You will be a critical force multiplier for our Technical Enablement team, enabling us to focus on strategy and solution viability while you drive delivery excellence, team operations, and cross-functional alignment. You will be successful in this role if you thrive in ambiguity, are able to navigate competing priorities with diplomacy, and have a builder's mentality.

What You’ll Do

Program & Delivery Leadership


Lead end-to-end program execution for marketing and advertising technology initiatives, ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery across multiple workstreams 
Translate high-level product strategy and architectural direction into executable plans, milestones, and delivery schedules 
Manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and delivery trade-offs 
Track progress, manage scope, and proactively surface delivery risks and mitigation plans 



Product Management


Own and act as the product manager for key Technical Enablement priorities when needed 
Contribute to AI Strategy and delivery of AI-related features 
Create product requirements documents and project charters 



Agile Operations & Team Orchestration


Serve as scrum master for our team of product managers, engineers, and strategists 
Lead PI planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily scrums, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

title: Senior Program Manager, AI
description:
## **About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

## **  
About the role**

Support Operations manage a global support organization of more than 1,000 employees with a lean team of 10. Our goal isn't just to support the business, but to automate the friction out of it. We are looking for an **AI-Native Program Manager** to force-multiply our global Support organization through AI. You will own the internal AI roadmap, executing on three core pillars: upskilling the Operations team to automate complex tasks in each function, empowering cross-functional leads to optimize their workflows, and building custom internal tools that directly reduce agent handle time and improve support quality.

  
Reporting to the Head of Support Operations, you will be responsible for setting the internal AI roadmap and executing against it to improve Support quality and efficiency.

## **  
What you will do**

*   **Upskill the Ops Engine:** Train our Ops team of 10 to leverage AI so they can operate at the scale of 50. You will help them build and adopt new tools—for example, using LLMs to automate headcount forecasting models, increasing accuracy while drastically reducing manual spreadsheet maintenance.
*   **Empower Cross-Functional Leads:** Act as an internal AI consultant for our Support Leads, helping them deploy AI to drive specific departmental KPIs:
*   *   **Content Leads:** Implement AI workflows to boost self-serve deflection rates and improve ticket routing accuracy.
    *   **R&D Leads:** Streamline how complex bugs are triaged and how Jira tickets are drafted for Engineering.
    *   **Training Leads:** Accelerate the creation, translation, and refinement of global training materials.
    
*   **Build Custom Internal Tools:** Go hands-on to prototype and deploy internal tools designed to reduce agent cognitive load, lower handle time, and improve overall quality (e.g., building a workflow that automatically flags resolved edge-case tickets to generate new Knowledge Base content).

## **  
What you will need**

*   **AI-Native:** You don't just use Gemini; you have a library of custom Gems, you understand how to use Claude Projects for coding assistance, and you’ve experimented with tools like Cursor and Vercel
*   **Systems Thinker:** You have 4 - 6 years of experience in Support/Sales/Revenue Ops. You understand the "logic" of a 1,000-person organization (scaling, time zones, regional labor laws).
*   **The "Scrappy" Architect:** You prefer building a custom solution that works over buying an expensive enterprise "AI module" that doesn't.
*   **Data Literate (But Not a Scientist):** You don't need to build neural networks, but you must be able to query SQL and understand how to feed clean data into an LLM for accurate reporting.
*   **Technical Flavor**
*   *   **Required:** Deep familiarity with the LLM landscape (Cursor, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Python)
    *   **Preferred:** Experience with Support Tech (Salesforce, JIRA, etc.) and BI tools like (Looker/Tableau).
    

## **  
Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

129,200 - 191,100 USD per year(US Tier 1)  
118,280 - 171,990 USD per year(US Tier 2)  
112,820 - 162,435 USD per year(US Tier 3)

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
This role is eligible for full-time remote within the US. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time.

**Who We Are**

At Arpio, we're building the next generation of cloud disaster recovery, specifically designed for the modern enterprise. We understand the growing list of threats to cloud workloads and the complexity of managing disaster recovery in those environments.

That's why we have created the easiest to use, most reliable SaaS solution on the market. Arpio protects your entire AWS workload from disaster with just a few clicks. No more time-consuming setup, risky manual processes, or sleepless nights.

But we're more than just a product. We're a small, passionate team (YC W21 (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/arpio)) fueled by the thrill of tackling tough challenges and shaping the future. We're not afraid to learn, grow, and push boundaries to build something truly innovative.

  

  
**About the Role**

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical advisor for Arpio customers throughout their lifecycle.

As a member of our Customer Success team, you'll partner closely with Arpio Product and Engineering. You'll embed with customers from onboarding onwards to deeply understand the details of their AWS & Azure cloud environments, resilience goals, and the ways in which Arpio can best be deployed for maximum effectiveness.

In this role, you'll strive to understand customer requirements and issues at the granular level. You'll have a natural curiosity and desire to identify the root causes of customer problems, and empathetically solve them. You'll feel comfortable navigating from ambiguity to clarity, designing creative solutions that leverage the Arpio product and AWS & Azure best practices.

  

  
**Responsibilities**

*   Act as a trusted technical advisor for Arpio customers through all stages of their lifecycle including implementation, disaster recovery planning, and failover testing
*   Improve customer experience by participating in onboarding meetings, account reviews, and other sessions where you contribute expertise on technical topics.
*   Cultivate a deep understanding of customer environments, as well as their resilience goals in AWS & Azure, so as to provide clear and proactive technical guidance to ensure success.
*   Become an Arpio product expert; advising customers on the best ways to deploy the Arpio solution based on their unique requirements.
*   Leverage your product knowledge as well as your expertise in cloud and hybrid cloud engineering, networking, and resilience strategies to deliver timely and organized solutions for customers.
*   Serve as a technical voice of the customer in the product engineering lifecycle. Identify and document product gaps to promote customer retention and satisfaction.
*   Accurately capture customer feature requests; collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to define scope and relative priority.
*   Assist with technical troubleshooting and escalations of reported issues promptly and persistently.
*   Contribute to the Arpio customer base through knowledge-sharing activities such as contributing to internal and external documentation, answering technical Q&A, and helping iterate on best practices.
*   This role may require occasional travel to attend meetings with customers, conferences, and other industry events.

  

  
**Requirements**

*   10+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role at companies in similar spaces, with a demonstrated track record of success
*   Deep cloud expertise, with knowledge of how to set up and deploy common environments
*   Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent experience
*   Working knowledge of Active Directory
*   Working knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS
*   Experience configuring & troubleshooting cloud and hybrid networking technologies; ability to dive into details around common topics such as DNS, routing, and connectivity
*   Passion for collaborating with customers to understand their use case
*   Skilled at getting to the core of a customer problem and developing the best solution to meet their needs
*   Strong communication skills with an ability to meet customers at their technical level, taking complex concepts and making them easily understood
*   Comfort with the fast-paced, ambiguous nature of an early stage company
*   US resident

  

  
**Nice to Have**

*   It's a plus if you're located in the Triangle Region of North Carolina - we have an office and a core team located in RTP, NC, and hybrid working is an option
*   Startup experience
*   AWS Solutions Architect Associate Certification
*   Release management experience
*   Experience with observability tools

  

  
**Salary and Benefits**

*   Competitive salary and company equity package
*   Fully employer-paid health benefits package; 75% employer-paid dental, vision and life insurance
*   Unlimited PTO policy
*   Small, collaborative team environment with lots of autonomy
*   Opportunity to learn and work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

title: Program Manager
description:
About the job

LightFeather is seeking a Program Manager to lead 4–8 Agile software development teams (representing 40–80 technical staff) delivering mission-critical systems for federal customers. This role is for someone who owns outcomes end-to-end—people, delivery, risk, and customer relationships—not a task-runner or meeting note-taker.

Job Type: Full Time

Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required

Ensure all development teams deliver against technical, functional, and quality expectations.

10+ years of professional experience, including 6–8 years of software delivery project/program management.

Demonstrated success managing 40–80 technical staff across multiple workstreams.
Experience managing subcontractors, staffing plans, and team performance.

Experience with CPARS, federal deliverables, LOE management, and contract management.


Why Join LightFeather?

At LightFeather, you're not just taking a job—you're joining a purpose-driven team that delivers innovative, mission-critical solutions to make a real difference. You'll work on diverse, meaningful projects that challenge and inspire you, alongside some of the best minds in the industry.

title: Wisconsin Program Manager
description:
About the job

Position Summary:

Somos Votantes/Somos PAC is seeking a dynamic beginning to mid level Program Manager to join our team in Wisconsin. A successful candidate will play a key role in developing, planning and implementing state programs and goals, understanding the state legislative and political landscapes while working closely with organizations and individuals in-state and nationally. The Program Manager will also work with the Somos Team to grow the Somos’ organizational brand in the state by building and maintaining a strong and engaged network of organizations and individuals. Candidates should have a love for building community, making new relationships and building a program from the ground up. This position is based in Wisconsin and requires some travel around the state and at times travel nationally. This position reports to the National Partnership & Program Director. This position will not manage a staff and will be the point person in state.




Organization Overview:

Somos Votantes is a Latino-led, founded, and focused organization dedicated to increasing the collective impact of Latinos. We are dedicated to empowering and educating Latino communities with the knowledge, tools and opportunities they need to participate in our democracy and create meaningful change in their communities. At Somos Votantes, we empower our community to make their voices heard to create positive change for themselves, their families, and their communities. We specialize in culturally competent community organizing and connecting with our community on issues that impact their daily lives, advocate for policies that will make their lives better, and help break down barriers that keep them from actively engaging in our democracy.




Key Responsibilities:

Program Planning and Implementation
 Under direction of the National Partnership & Program Director, identify and create Wisconsin specific program work plans, including developing metrics of success and monitoring progress towards goals.
Track, maintain, and report out on Wisconsin project & program metrics, collateral and data on various weekly internal and external calls.
 Responsible for developing and executing community events and bringing them to fruition. Additionally, will maintain event plans and budgets while effectively communicating with Somos
Team members to inform them on relevant updates and event needs.
Support and engage in state efforts for the 2026 elections with state coalition partners.
Community Leadership and Outreach
Responsible for identifying, cultivating, and maintaining strong individual and organizational relationships with a broad range of coalitions and grassroots contacts that align with state specific issues and/or electoral programs in Wisconsin.
Identify and hold a variety of 1:on:1 meetings, group presentations, and general community outreach to community members, coalition partners, and coalition leaders to educate and engage community members around Somos Wisconsin priorities.
Identify and participate in community tabling & community events to promote Somos Votantes programs. Additionally, attend and support events of Somos coalition partners and allies including attending other coalition meetings and trainings in Wisconsin.
Update, maintain, and report on the status of in-state individual and organizational relationships with aligned organizations and leaders. This will be achieved by attending, capturing notes, and reporting out on various in-state and national stakeholder meetings and conferences, including a focus on partner coalitions such as America Votes.




Volunteer Coordination and Engagement
Under supervision of the National Partnership & Program Director, develop, and implement strategies to build a large volunteer and/or coalition network, with a focus on distributed organizing tactics, training volunteers, and achieving organizational goals.
Conduct weekly phone calls to follow up, recruit, and retain volunteers previously identified from community events, canvassing efforts, and other lead generating avenues.
Update and maintain volunteer contact list by utilizing CRM systems such as the Voter Action Network (VAN).




Interdepartmental Collaboration and Communication
Working collaboratively with Somos’ existing staff and consultants on areas of focus work including; research, digital media, and data collecting
Work in collaboration with the National Communications and Media team to respond to media opportunities and, when needed, participate in media interviews for Somos with a goal of celebrating our work and impact with Latino voters. In addition provide materials from Wisconsin events, share partner social media and information to maintain a web and social media presence.
Manage and oversee the daily operational and administrative components of Wisconsin programs; which can include submitting reports, emails, data input, and updating other work products on a weekly basis. Develop, monitor, and maintain departmental systems and processes.




Campaign Reporting & Planning
Identify, track, and report on any and all legislative developments that are relevant to Wisconsin specific programs.
Identify, track, and report on political dynamics to understand the political legislative and electoral landscape in Wisconsin.




Other responsibilities and duties as assigned




Qualifications:

Demonstrated commitment to the organization's mission and values.
At least one to three years of experience in progressive political campaigns, progressive non-profits or similar organizations (with a campaign focus), or similar transferable experience and a minimum two years of project management experience.
Must have a valid driver license, reliable transportation, and active car insurance.
Strong attention to detail - Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal and can support the creation and development of written Wisconsin products.
Strong leadership skills with ability to motivate and lead project teams, while also being a team player.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with internal/external teams.
Experience developing and maintaining credible and productive relationships with elected officials, coalition partners, community leaders and volunteers.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities and timelines.
Has experience working in Google Suite (Google Sheets, Google Slides, ect) or Microsoft Suite (Excel, Power Point, ect)
Spanish language proficiency is highly desirable but not required.
Must be able to travel within the entire service area and work evenings and weekends as required.




Preferred Skills

Passion for the Somos Votantes Mission: A strong passion for the mission and the ability to articulate the importance and impact of the organization's work to potential supporters.
Ownership: The ability to assume ownership for producing the best possible result in the area of work and being able to hold self and others accountable for meeting commitments while creating and supporting a climate in which people can do their best.
Communication: The ability to demonstrate effective written and oral communication skills tailoring communications to diverse audiences. Actively listens, provides constructive feedback, seeks feedback and demonstrates respect for differing views.
Initiative & Attitude: The ability to proactively initiate tasks and work independently with humility, maintaining a positive attitude and demonstrating flexibility to perform additional tasks as assigned.
Agility: Have the ability to adapt rapidly to changing circumstances, anticipate problems and work proactively to solve them. Welcome new direction eagerly and be open to varying perspectives when offered. Takes redirection as a growth opportunity, reflects on implementing lessons learned to do even better in future endeavors.
Relationship Building and Inclusivity: The ability to find and create opportunities to deepen connections and build authentic, mutual relationships across lines of difference. Actively seeks others’ perspectives to ensure inclusiveness and understanding.
Project Planning, Delivery & Risk Management: The ability to develop comprehensive project plans that consider all aspects of the project, including accurate time estimates and risks. The ability to work with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and partners to deliver projects successfully.
Process Improvement and Quality Management: The ability to improve processes and practices by identifying inefficiencies and redundancies while offering solutions that increase efficiency and improve quality. When overseeing a project/program able to oversee all activities and tasks that must be accomplished to maintain desired outcomes with high quality.
Problem Solving and Judgement: The ability to critically evaluate conditions, tasks and projects; be able to identify problems and risks, causes and relationships; find solutions to identified problems that are based on research, data, or sound reasoning.
Experience working with and in communities of color.




Compensation: This is a full time exempt cycle position that runs through December 2026. The pay range is equivalent to $75,000 - $80,000 yearly salary and is commensurate with experience.




Benefits: Somos Votantes provides a generous paid time off policy with paid vacation, paid sick leave, personal days, paid Federal holidays, and paid organizational time off from at least Dec 23 to January 1st yearly. Somos Votantes provides staff cell phone reimbursement, and up to 80% of employee healthcare reimbursed.




How to Apply: To apply, please submit a resume and optional but highly recommended cover letter to

jobs@somosvotantes.org. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.




Somos Votantes is an equal opportunity employer. Somos Votantes encourages candidates from all

backgrounds to apply.

The Senior Support Engineer helps customers succeed on our cloud-based application running on Azure with a SQL server backend and a .NET/C# codebase. This position has ownership of escalated, high-impact issues - reproducing problems, interrogating telemetry and logs, querying databases, and performing disciplined root-cause analysis. This position communicates clearly with customers, coordinates with engineering, and (when appropriate) ships small, safe fixes or automation to reduce repeat incidents.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

Customer-facing incident ownership (L3 escalation)

*   Own escalated cases from intake to resolution: triage, severity assessment, containment, fix/mitigation, and customer updates.
*   Translate ambiguous customer symptoms into testable hypotheses and actionable next steps.
*   Outcomes: measurable improvements in time-to-mitigation, time-to-resolution, and CSAT on escalated cases.

Deep troubleshooting and root-cause analysis

*   Use observability tools to investigate failures and performance regressions (logs, traces, metrics). For Azure-based systems, this commonly involves Azure Monitor / Application Insights / Log Analytics workflows.
*   Debug .NET/C# services (locally and in controlled production scenarios) to identify code, configuration, or dependency causes.
*   Outcomes: consistent delivery of high-quality RCA write-ups (what happened, why, customer impact, and prevention plan) and reduced repeat incidents.

SQL Server / data-layer investigation

*   Write and optimize T-SQL queries to validate data integrity, reproduce issues, and assess impact.
*   Use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) daily to inspect schemas, analyze queries, and gather evidence.
*   Outcomes: faster diagnosis of data-related issues; fewer incidents caused by bad data or query regressions.

Production support with strong safety and judgment

*   Safely access production systems following runbooks and least-privilege practices; document actions taken and results.
*   Identify when escalation to engineering/on-call is required vs. when the issue can be resolved within support.
*   Outcomes: correct severity calls, minimal operational risk, clear audit trail.

Engineering partnership and continuous improvement

*   File high-signal bug reports (repro steps, logs, impact, suspected commit/component) and collaborate with engineering through to closure.
*   For smaller issues, implement low-risk code fixes (e.g., defensive checks, better error handling, logging improvements) and follow PR standards.
*   Create/update runbooks and knowledge base articles to shift repeated work left.
*   Proactively monitor the health of our environment: identify, escalate, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and incidents.
*   Outcomes: reduced backlog of recurring issues; improved self-service and Tier 1/2 deflection.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

*   Minimum of five (5) years in technical support, application support, production operations, SRE-adjacent support, or software engineering with significant on-call/incident responsibility.
*   Strong proficiency debugging C# / .NET applications (reading code, tracing execution, diagnosing exceptions, validating fixes).
*   Strong proficiency with SQL Server and T-SQL, including investigative querying and basic query performance awareness.
*   Hands-on experience with SSMS and routine database investigation workflows.
*   Practical experience using observability to troubleshoot production issues (logs/metrics/traces). Familiarity with Azure Monitor / Application Insights is highly aligned with this role.
*   Working knowledge of Azure fundamentals (Azure Portal navigation, common services, deployments, identity/access concepts).
*   Experience working customer-facing escalations: clear written updates, expectation-setting, and technical explanations for mixed audiences.
*   Comfort operating in an incident process (ticketing, triage, comms, postmortems/RCA).
*   A solid grasp of cloud security and best practices and an understanding of compliance standards such as HIPAA and HITRUST.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

*   Experience supporting production workloads on AWS
*   Hands-on troubleshooting in Kubernetes environments and familiarity with how applications are exposed and routed inside a cluster.
*   Practical container experience with Docker.
*   Proficiency working with DataDog (metrics, dashboards, monitors/alerts)
*   Experience querying and troubleshooting PostgreSQL
*   Familiarity with Snowflake
*   Familiarity with Azure DevOps (repos, PRs, pipelines) and CI/CD fundamentals.
SQL performance tuning experience.

title: Senior Developer Advocate with verification
description:
About the job

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About Deepgram

Deepgram is the leading voice AI platform for developers; building speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS) and full speech-to-speech (STS), enterprise-grade, voice agent offerings. Over 200,000 developers build with Deepgram’s voice-native foundational models – accessed through APIs, well known partners or as self-managed software – due to our unmatched accuracy, latency and pricing.

Customers include software companies building voice products, co-sell partners working with large enterprises, and enterprises solving internal voice AI use cases. The company ended 2024 cash-flow positive with 400+ enterprise customers, 3.3x annual usage growth across the past 4 years, over 50,000 years of audio processed and over 1 trillion words transcribed. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

About The Role

As a Senior Developer Advocate, you are the builder and storyteller who proves what's possible with voice AI — and then shows developers exactly how to do it themselves.

You ship reference apps, demos, and technical content that move developers from curiosity to production. You find the friction points before anyone else does and turn them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering. You show up where developers are — online and in person — and earn trust through technical depth, empathy, and consistency.

This is a high-autonomy role. You identify the gaps, define the approach, and drive work to measurable outcomes. You're deep in the Advocacy pillar (content, demos, community, narrative) and proficient in the Experience pillar (you can contribute to SDKs, recipes, and docs when the work calls for it). Your output moves the needle on adoption and retention, not just activity metrics.

We're looking for someone based on the US East Coast who can be Deepgram's in-person presence at events, meetups, and workshops in the NY metro area and across the US.

What You’ll Do


Ship Reference Apps & Demos: Architect and open-source sample apps that solve real-world challenges — building real-time voice agents, orchestrating multiple voice AI models, streaming audio intelligence pipelines. Every demo should be runnable, well-documented, and designed for developers to learn from and build on.
Code-First Content: Produce deep-dives, video walkthroughs, and "build-in-public" documentation that moves developers from idea to working prototype in minutes. You write and build for developers.
Be the "Zero-Index" Sensor: Act as the first customer for every new feature and API change. Turn feedback from your own builds and from the developer community into Friction Reports that influence Product and Engineering priorities.
Own Technical Narrative: Author high-quality technical content across blogs, social media, and video platforms that establishes Deepgram as the default choice for voice AI.
Community Engagement: Engage where developers live (GitHub, Reddit, X, Discord, Hacker News) to represent Deepgram, answer questions, and earn community trust through consistent technical presence.
In-Person Advocacy: Serve as Deepgram's on-the-ground presence primarily in the US. Lead workshops, speak at meetups and AI conferences, and build relationships with the developer community. Expect ~25% travel.
Cross-Pillar Contributions: Contribute to the Developer Experience pillar - building integration recipes, improving SDK documentation, or building demo tooling.
Multiply the Team: Document your processes and playbooks. Mentor teammates on content strategy, demo architecture, and community engagement patterns
Connect Work to Outcomes: Frame your impact in terms of developer outcomes — sign-ups, activations, content-to-trial conversion, community growth. Articulate the business case and impact for your work.


What We’re Looking For


Experience: 5+ years in Software Engineering or Developer Relations. You've shipped production code and you've shipped developer-facing content
Tech Stack: Solid foundation in JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, Rust, or Go. You're comfortable building APIs, wiring up integrations, and creating clean frontends to showcase your work.
AI-First Mindset: You use AI tools in your daily workflow for coding, content, research, automation. You're not just building AI demos; you're productive with AI.
Educator Mindset: A portfolio of technical writing, blog posts, talks, or video content that demonstrates that you can make complex topics land with a developer audience.
Community Fluency: Experience participating in or building developer communities. You know how to engage with empathy and technical credibility, and when to step back and let the community lead.
Technical Communicator: You simplify complex AI orchestration through clear writing, documentation, and high-quality code samples. Developers trust your explanations.
High Autonomy: You proactively find the gaps, define the plan, and drive to outcomes without waiting to be pointed at a problem.
Location: US East Coast, with the ability to attend and represent Deepgram at events in the NY metro area. Some travel beyond the region (~25%) for conferences and team gatherings.


Preferred / Nice-to-Have


Deep AI Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience with the broader "AI Agent" stack — LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate), and RAG architecture.
Media & Real-time Protocols: Experience working with WebSockets, WebRTC, or gRPC. If you understand how audio bytes move across the wire in real-time, you are a top-tier candidate.
Engineering Influence: A history of collaborating directly with Product and Engineering teams to shape an API roadmap based on developer friction.
Industry Recognition: A digital presence that could span a technical YouTube or Twitch channel, a newsletter, conference speaking history, or OSS contributions that show you've started building an audience.
Open Source Leadership: Experience as a maintainer or major contributor to a well-known open-source project, with a focus on community governance and developer onboarding.
Cross-Language Versatility: Demonstrating the ability to work across multiple languages to support enterprise-grade reference patterns is a major plus.
Automation Mindset: Experience with AI-assisted coding tools or custom CLI utilities to automate your own advocacy workflow.


Why This Role Matters

Deepgram wins when developers move from "is this possible?" to "this is in production" with zero friction. The East Coast is home to a massive concentration of AI developers, startups, and enterprises building voice-native products. This role puts Deepgram in the room — at meetups, at conferences, in the communities where builders are making technology decisions. As a Senior Developer Advocate for Deepgram, you're the person who earns developer trust through the code you ship, the content you create, and the relationships you build in person.

Benefits & Perks*

Holistic health


Medical, dental, vision benefits
Annual wellness stipend
Mental health support
Life, STD, LTD Income Insurance Plans


Work/life blend


Unlimited PTO
Generous paid parental leave
Flexible schedule
12 Paid US company holidays
Quarterly personal productivity stipend
One-time stipend for home office upgrades
401(k) plan with company match
Tax Savings Programs


Continuous learning


Learning / Education stipend
Participation in talks and conferences
Employee Resource Groups
AI enablement workshops / sessions
For candidates outside of the US, we use an Employer of Record model in many countries, which means benefits are administered locally and governed by country-specific regulations. Because of this, benefits will differ by region — in some cases international employees receive benefits US employees do not, and vice versa. As we scale, we will continue to evaluate where we can create more alignment, but a 1:1 global benefits structure is not always legally or operationally possible.


Backed by prominent investors including Y Combinator, Madrona, Tiger Global, Wing VC and NVIDIA, Deepgram has raised over $215M in total funding. If you're looking to work on cutting-edge technology and make a significant impact in the AI industry, we'd love to hear from you!

Deepgram is an equal opportunity employer. We want all voices and perspectives represented in our workforce. We are a curious bunch focused on collaboration and doing the right thing. We put our customers first, grow together and move quickly. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

title: Senior Technical Sales Engineer
description:
We're an award-winning data, media and tech consultancy and a leading Google and Adobe partner that helps brands and agencies think beyond clicks and conversions to unlock new opportunities for growth. We thrive on rolling up our sleeves and digging into the tough stuff for our 800+ clients. And we love getting them the most ROI from their digital marketing. If you're up for the challenge, join us. Let's move fearlessly forward together.

**Job Title:** Senior Technical Sales Engineer

**Compensation:** $135,000 to $155,000

**Location:** Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

Adswerve is looking for a Senior Technical Sales Engineer to join our Solutions Architecture team! This is a high-impact, client-facing role at the intersection of data science, cloud infrastructure, and sales strategy. You will serve as the technical authority in major sales pursuits, translating complex Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AI capabilities into compelling, differentiated narratives for Fortune 500 clients.

You will partner closely with Solutions Architecture leadership, internal sales teams, and Google partnership contacts to develop and deliver winning proposals - while also collaborating with Technical Services on delivery continuity. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in a boardroom and a BigQuery editor.

### **Responsibilities**

Pre-Sales & Client Engagement

*   Lead technical discovery sessions with prospective and existing clients across retail, hospitality, entertainment, and e-commerce verticals
*   Own the development of custom demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical narratives for major GCP-focused sales pitches
*   Partner with Solutions Architecture and sales leadership to craft winning RFP responses, SOW scoping, and executive-level presentations

Technical Execution

*   Operate hands-on in GCP environments, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Looker, and related data and AI tooling
*   Develop reusable demo assets and solution frameworks that can be deployed across the sales organization
*   Apply data science fundamentals to design technically sound, client-specific use cases spanning ML, marketing analytics, and AI activation
*   Stay current on Google Cloud roadmap developments, GMP integrations, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to our go-to-market strategy

Internal Collaboration

*   Serve as a bridge between the Solutions Architecture and Technical Services teams, ensuring pre-sales commitments are grounded in delivery feasibility
