title: Founding AI Engineer / Platform Architect (Hands-On)
description:
About the job

Company Description




MyWhatIf is building a new category of AI-powered human development technology designed to help people restore hope, agency, and meaning after trauma, disruption, and major life transitions.




Through AI-guided narrative exploration, reflective dialogue, and personalized simulations, the platform enables individuals to explore alternative life paths, reframe limiting beliefs, and imagine new possibilities for their future.




We have completed the first proof of concept and are now entering the next stage: transforming the prototype into a scalable production platform capable of supporting a growing global user base and expanding AI-powered capabilities.




Role Description




We are looking for a Founding AI Engineer / Platform Architect to help lead the next stage of development of the MyWhatIf platform.




This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both designing systems and building them. You will help transform the existing prototype into a secure, scalable production platform while continuing to develop new capabilities.




The role combines AI system design, platform architecture, and full-stack development. You will evaluate the current system, strengthen its technical foundations, and guide the architecture as the platform evolves.




Key areas of development include:

AI-driven narrative simulations
personalization systems based on user history and context
reflective dialogue experiences
visual storytelling and immersive narrative formats
scalable data systems that support research, impact measurement, and clinical collaboration




Because MyWhatIf sits at the intersection of AI, psychology, and human development, the platform must support emotionally sensitive interactions while maintaining strong privacy protections, secure data architecture, and research-ready infrastructure.




As a founding engineer, you will play a central role in shaping the technical direction of the platform while remaining deeply involved in implementation and experimentation. Over time, you may also help guide additional developers and contribute to the evolution of MyWhatIf’s AI infrastructure, including the development of proprietary models optimized for narrative exploration and human-centered AI interaction.




What we're looking for




We are looking for a builder who can move comfortably between system architecture and hands-on development.




The ideal candidate understands modern AI ecosystems, including large language models and emerging AI architectures, and enjoys designing systems that are both innovative and practical.

Important qualities include:




strong experience building scalable platforms and AI-enabled products
deep familiarity with modern LLM ecosystems and AI system design
ability to make thoughtful technical decisions in early-stage environments
comfort balancing performance, cost efficiency, and scalability
interest in building ethical, human-centered AI systems




This is a rare opportunity to help build the technical foundation of a platform designed to support people navigating trauma, major life transitions, and personal transformation.

title: Product Solution Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – Product Solution Engineer, Product Solution Engineering**

  

**About Intelex**

At Intelex, we’re not just building software; we’re empowering organizations worldwide to create safer, more sustainable, and higher-performing workplaces. As a global leader in Environment, Health, Safety (EHS), Quality, and Sustainability Management Software, Intelex is dedicated to transforming the way companies manage workplace safety, compliance, and operational excellence. Our technology enables companies to proactively manage risk to keep people and the planet safe.

  

**About the role**

The Product Solution Engineering Team sits at the intersection of customer pain and product strategy. We've evolved from traditional scrum teams to cross-functional squads building features that solve real customer problems at scale. We also partner with our ecosystem to extend capabilities beyond our core platform, ensuring a cohesive experience for customers.

As a **Product Solution Engineer (PSE)**, you'll build scalable configuration solutions using low-code platforms (primarily the Intelex platform) and experiment with AI-assisted development to validate product hypotheses faster. You'll work embedded in product squads, translating customer requirements into technical solutions that influence our roadmap. For this senior role, you'll also bring deep platform expertise to guide build-versus-partner decisions and ensure our partner ecosystem aligns with product strategy.

  

**How you’ll make a difference:**

**Solution Validation & Building (50%)**

*   Design and build advanced configuration solutions on the Intelex platform for complex customer use cases
Progress solutions through Build 1 (5 customers) Build 2 (50 customers)*   Build 3 (500+ customers) maturity stages
*   Identify patterns across customer requirements to build generalizable solutions rather than one-offs
*   Partner with Engineering teams from day one to ensure smooth productization handoff
*   Translate customer pain points into technical requirements for product squads
*   Participate in Voice of Customer (VOC) sessions and occasional customer site visits

**Platform & Partner Strategy (30%)**

*   Contribute to "build versus partner" decisions for applications and integrations, leveraging your deep understanding of Intelex platform capabilities and partner ecosystem
*   Review design of partner-developed applications to ensure platform integrity, scalability, and alignment with product strategy
*   Provide technical guidance on partner integration feasibility and architecture
*   Educate internal teams (Services, Support, Sales) on Intelex platform capabilities and partner offerings
*   Collaborate with Partnership Org to establish partner development guidelines

**Innovation & Team Leadership (20%)**

*   Experiment with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to build rapid prototypes for validation
*   Mentor PSE team members on Intelex platform best practices, scalable configuration patterns, and common pitfalls
*   Contribute to our evolving Rapid Validation Playbook based on what works in practice
*   Share insights that inform partner development frameworks and integration standards

  

**What you bring to the table:**

**Required Experience & Skills**

*   4-6 years building solutions on low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, OutSystems, Mendix, PowerApps, Intelex)
*   2+ years Intelex platform experience strongly preferred - we need deep platform expertise to guide partner decisions and mentor the team
*   Proven ability to scale solutions from prototype to production—you've seen what happens when one-off solutions need to serve hundreds of customers
*   Strong systems thinking: you naturally identify patterns across use cases and design for generalization, not just the immediate request
*   Experience working in product-focused environments where iteration speed matters more than architectural purity
*   Partner ecosystem familiarity: you've implemented partner integrations or applications and understand how they extend platform capabilities
*   Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change—our processes are defined but evolving, and you'll help shape them

**Preferred Skills**

*   Understanding of low-code platforms beyond Intelex (Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) - helpful for bringing external best practices
*   EHSQ domain knowledge (understanding of compliance, auditing, incident management, etc.)
*   Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Goose, Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, etc.)
*   Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for customization work
*   Experience with remote collaboration across time zones

**Work Traits We Value**

*   Pragmatic builder: You'd rather ship a working solution today than a perfectly architected solution next quarter
*   Customer-obsessed: You care deeply about solving real problems, not just checking technical boxes
*   Intellectually curious: You experiment with new tools and approaches, then share what you learn
*   Collaborative: You work well embedded in product squads and don't need to be the hero
*   Resilient: You're comfortable being uncomfortable – rapid iteration means things change, and that excites rather than drains you

  

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field. Equivalent practical experience building platform-based solutions will also be considered.

  

**Who This Role Is NOT For**

Be honest with yourself before applying. This role isn't a fit if you:

*   Want to write production code in Java/Python/C# all day (that's Engineering's role)
*   Need highly structured processes and clear 12-month roadmaps (we're iterating rapidly)
*   Prefer deep technical architecture over pragmatic solutions (we optimize for speed of learning)
*   View this as pure partner management (you'll contribute to partner strategy, but 70% of your time is building and validating product solutions)

  

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a brief note (3-4 paragraphs) answering these questions:

1\. What low-code/no-code platform(s) have you built solutions on, and what's the most complex use case you've scaled from prototype to production?

2\. Describe a time when you had to generalize a customer-specific requirement into a solution that could serve many customers. What was your approach?

3\. Have you experimented with AI-assisted development tools? If yes, what did you build and what did you learn?

\*\*Bonus question for Intelex platform experts:\*\*

4\. What's the most complex Intelex configuration you've built, and what did you learn about scaling it from one customer to many?

  

_We value thoughtful, specific answers over generic cover letters. Show us how you think, not just what you've done._

**  
Fortive Corporation Overview**

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

title: Senior National Account Manager - Walmart & Sam's Club with verification
description:
About the job

Darigold is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior National Account Manager (Sr. NAM) of Walmart & Sam’s Club to join our team. The Sr. NAM is responsible for creating value for our Farmers and Customers, by delivering volume, share and margin growth through the execution of Darigold’s brand and business development plans, including, but not limited to the execution of strategic sales plans with key national and regional customers, deliver new product distribution and improve operating margins through effective merchandising, pricing, promotion management and effective sales planning and forecasting.

The Sr. NAM is a key member of the B2C Sales Team reporting to the VP of Sales. This role requires exceptional organizational skills and analytical acumen. The ideal candidate will be customer first focused and have a passion for learning to maximize total enterprise value with customers across several channels, categories and product offerings for branded and private label growth. This role will directly manage complex customer relationships and should be capable of facilitating contract negotiations and new business RFP bids. To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will be self-motivated and self-directed with a passion to find new opportunities to grow the business. This role will need to be a skilled internal collaborator and will need to successfully partner with cross functional teammates in Business Development, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, IT, HR and the Northwest Dairy Association Team to drive optimal results.

Darigold is the fifth largest dairy cooperative in the United States based on milk volume and one of the largest privately held organizations headquartered in the state of Washington. Since 1918, our producers have taken pride in producing dairy products with unsurpassed quality. Today, we are one of the nation's largest agricultural cooperatives, producing over 8.5 billion pounds of milk every year.

Through innovative technology and our efficient, flexible production capabilities, we deliver value added products and customer-driven solutions. Darigold is now known throughout the world for bringing fresh, wholesome dairy products and ingredients from the Northwest to people all around the globe.

What You Will Do 


Deliver volume, margin, share, objectives for Walmart & Sam’s Club.
Execute Darigold’s customer and business development plans, for core branded and private label products as outlined in the AOP, DSMP’s and Price and Trade Architecture, to include:
Drive product distribution.
Deliver quality merchandising and efficient pricing and promotion management.
Provide accurate sales and trade planning and forecasting.
Facilitating effective customer service and order fulfillment.
Ensure effective execution of invoice accuracy, deduction management and enforcement of credit policies, terms and conditions.
Execute Darigold’s brand to consumer plans to include:
Drive new products distribution both in depth and breadth.
Leverage brand and channel marketing programs and promotions to maximize new item velocities.

What You Will Bring


Bachelor’s degree required.
5+ plus years of Consumer Products Sales, National Account or Category Management experience required.
2+ plus years of Walmart experience preferred.
Dairy, Refrigerated and/or Private Label experience preferred.
Must be willing/able to travel up to 25-50% of the time.
Customer Savvy: Leading with clarity, to cultivate a relationship of mutual trust and respect to gain expert understanding of the customer’s structure, cultural ways of working, category expectations and business requirements, to create sustainably value and growth for the customer and Darigold. Customer expert looking to uncover all opportunities and to grow with the account and to understand the competition. Own and develop JBP for growth at each account.
Execution Excellence: Planning thoroughly, collaborating and delivering the results that Darigold and the retailer expect while having an adept ability to drive contingency planning.
Negotiating Skills: Skillfully navigate tough situations with both internal and external groups; can settle differences and win concessions without damaging relationships and Darigold’s reputation and P&L; can manage strategic account relationships that elevate above transactional pricing and trade. 
Business Acumen: Owner mindset and a clear sense of accountability based on being knowledgeable and current on internal and external business conditions, trends and competitive activity.
Functional Skills: Effective user of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and can navigate company and third-party databases, customer portals and should possess strong written and verbal communication skills.
Analytic agility: Synthesize customer, consumer, category, competitive and company insights into executable winning customer plans and tactics that drive mutual wins for the retailer, Darigold and our end consumer.
Organizational agility: Knowledgeable about how the enterprise works and is effective at get things done through formal processes and informal relationship building. Must be able to handle ambiguity in a start-up type company culture.
Attention to detail: Detailed focused and organized. Must be able to meet customer timelines and all complete customer contracts.
Presents and communicates effectively: Develops and delivers multi-mode communications that coveys clear understanding to multiple types of audiences and influences others to act.
Problem solving and opportunity searching: Anticipate obstacles and dig for answers to solve issues. Must have the drive to find new business opportunities in existing accounts and find new ways to drive the business forward. 
Leadership: Action oriented, focuses on driving results, acts with integrity and alignment when leading self and others, embraces the company vision of leading Dairy forward and facilitates productive and positive interactions with teammates that drives results.
Stewardship: Demonstrates an enterprise value mindset that includes creating value for our farmers, employees and customers, acts as a responsible steward of Darigold’s assets including our reputation and advocates as a champion of dairy farming and the Northwest Dairy Association.
Perseverance: Sets high standards and goals for self and others, demonstrates resourcefulness in the face of obstacles and challenges, maintains a solution-oriented mindset, realistic and possesses optimism when facing market volatility and dynamics.
Co-Op Spirit: Puts the whole of our Co-Op before its parts.


Benefits Of Working At Darigold

We understand that as an employee, benefits that support you and your family in and out of work are important. We’re proud to offer eligible positions a competitive total rewards package that includes:


401k competitive employer matching
Comprehensive medical, dental & vision benefits
Employer paid life & disability coverage
Paid time off and paid holidays
8 weeks paid parental leave
Education assistance
Employee assistance program


Our Commitment to Diversity

Achieving our vision to Lead Dairy Forward requires cultivating and supporting a team with varying backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are committed to providing a workplace based on mutual respect where all employees feel included and can bring their best and authentic selves to work every day. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and Affirmative Action Employer. We welcome all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, marital status, creed, religion, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. As a condition of employment applicants offered a role will be required to successfully pass our pre-employment background screen, receive a negative drug screen result & confirm eligibility to work in the U.S. We participate in E-Verify - please follow the links for details, English / Spanish & view our Right to Work Statement, English / Spanish.

title: Director of Engineering, Core Experience with verification
description:
About the job

About Super.com

We started Super.com to help maximize lives – both the lives of our customers and the lives of our team – so that everyone can experience all that life has to offer. For our employees, our promise is that Super.com is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to unlock one’s potential, where learning is celebrated and impact is realized.

We are more than a fast-paced, high-growth tech company; we care about our people and take career progression seriously. This is your career and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.

About The Role

As our Engineering Director for Core Experience, you’ll lead the teams responsible for the shared member experiences that connect Super.com’s product verticals.

This organization owns key surfaces and systems including the homepage and discovery experiences, membership management, and the benefits and rewards systems that power member value. It also provides the shared platform capabilities and operational support systems needed to deliver those experiences consistently across Super.com. Together, these capabilities help members understand and access the value available across the travel, fintech, and earnings products, while giving internal teams the tools and workflows needed to support the member experience effectively.

The organization will launch with five teams, three established and two being created. You’ll report to the VP Engineering and lead a group of Engineering Managers, ensuring strong execution, technical quality, and a cohesive member experience across the platform. You’ll be a key driver of engineering standards, best practices, and improvements to our product development lifecycle. While you may occasionally jump into technical details to unblock momentum, your real impact comes from architectural leadership, organizational clarity, and elevating execution across the teams you lead.

Super.com is actively evolving how we build software as AI becomes a core part of the product development lifecycle. As a Director in this organization, you will play a meaningful role in that transformation. You will help teams adopt modern AI-enabled engineering practices, rethink how work is designed and executed, and identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve both product capabilities and development velocity while maintaining strong architectural and product quality standards.

Our stack includes React on the frontend and Python/Node microservices on the backend. You’ll also work with GitLab, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Datadog, Amplitude, and Snowflake as you scale our systems and elevate the engineering craft across the org.

About The Team

Super.com engineering has four full-stack product development focus areas: fintech, travel, earnings, and a Super+ membership program to unite them all. Our dozens of microservices and event-driven architecture handle thousands of requests and events per second, ingest over 1TB of data per day, and process over $1MM per day in sales, leveraging state of the art infrastructure. We have more than 100 contributors to our codebase with highly skilled engineers across our teams. We work in close partnership with Product Managers, Designers, and QA in an agile/scrum, fast-paced, scaleup environment (that respects work/life balance). We focus on driving business value through ambitious technical achievement, and place a huge emphasis on providing the structure to fast-track our team members' growth.

What You’ll Be Working On


Own the technical strategy and delivery for the Core Experience organization, ensuring we’re building the systems and experiences that help members engage with the platform, discover value, and access membership benefits across Super.com.
Lead and develop Engineering Managers and their teams, providing coaching, clearing technical and organizational blockers, and driving strong performance across the organization.
Own the engineering systems behind Super+ membership value, including benefits, rewards, and credits that power member experiences across product verticals.
Lead development of key engagement and discovery surfaces, including the Super.com homepage and related experiences that help members explore the platform.
Build and evolve the membership management platform, enabling members to manage their membership, benefits, and value across the Super ecosystem
Develop and scale the systems that power benefits and credits, ensuring they can support new membership offerings and experiences as the platform grows.
Provide the shared platform capabilities that allow these experiences to operate consistently across product verticals, while reducing duplication and improving delivery speed across teams.
Support the systems and workflows that enable customer operations and service teams to deliver a smooth and effective member experience.
Enable personalized discovery and cross-sell experiences across Super.com products in partnership with Product, Design, and Data teams.
Help drive the organization’s adoption of modern AI enabled engineering practices. This includes evolving development workflows, enabling teams to use AI effectively across design, implementation, and testing, and identifying opportunities where AI can unlock new product capabilities.
Ensure work is distributed effectively across teams and that collaboration with vertical product teams is clear and efficient.
Guide architecture and system design decisions, raising the technical bar and ensuring systems scale reliably.
Shape the organizational structure, hiring plans, and talent strategy for the Core Experience engineering group.
Continuously improve the product development lifecycle, balancing velocity with long-term system sustainability.
Contribute to cross-vertical engineering initiatives including architecture standards, guild leadership, and engineering best practices.
Jump into technical discussions or code when it’s the fastest path to clarity or impact.


What We’re Looking For


At least 5 years of people leadership experience, including managing managers and senior ICs, with 2+ of those years at a Director level or equivalent.
Proven success leading a multi-team engineering organization delivering consumer-facing products, shared platforms, or both.
Experience building or scaling membership platforms, rewards systems, credits or loyalty mechanisms, or other shared product capabilities used across multiple teams.
Experience owning or contributing to shared platform capabilities or product infrastructure that support multiple product areas or verticals.
Experience partnering closely with Product, Design, Growth, Data, Operations, and Finance teams to deliver systems that power engagement, value discovery, and member support.
Strong interest in modern AI enabled software development and a desire to help teams incorporate AI into their workflows in a thoughtful and effective way.
Strong track record of delivering major product or platform initiatives while balancing speed, reliability, and long-term sustainability.
Prior depth as a Senior Software Engineer or Technical Lead (3+ years minimum), with strong architectural judgment and the ability to guide senior engineers toward sound technical decisions.
Strong understanding of modern web architectures, distributed systems, and microservice design patterns.
Deep expertise in either backend or frontend systems design, with working knowledge across the stack to evaluate architectural tradeoffs.
Comfortable reviewing and guiding implementations within JavaScript and Python ecosystems.
Experience designing and operating services at meaningful scale, including performance, reliability, and observability considerations.
Proven ability to drive strategic engineering initiatives including organizational design, OKR planning, and multi-team alignment in fast-moving environments.
Background in startup or scale-up environments where ambiguity, speed, and iteration are part of daily life.


Our Technology


We use a state of the art architecture powered by Node and Python microservices and React frontend
We use Postgres for storage, Redis for caching, and Snowflake for our data warehouse
We use Gitlab for version control and CI/CD, and our infrastructure is hosted on AWS, making use of Kubernetes, RDS, etc
We invest heavily in monitoring and automated alerting using Datadog
We use Amplitude for client-side metrics and experimentation
We use Material-UI and maintain our own component library, using Figma for mock-ups
We integrate with a multitude of third-parties to support our compliance, risk, and security policies


Nice To Have


Experience building membership, loyalty, rewards, or credit-based systems.
Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, or AI-driven product experiences that improve discovery, cross-sell, or engagement.
Experience building homepage, discovery, or engagement surfaces in consumer products.
Experience working on shared platform capabilities that support multiple product teams or business areas.
Experience working on systems that support customer operations or service workflows tied to the user experience.
Experience integrating with payment platforms such as Braintree, Adyen, or similar providers, particularly in the context of subscriptions, memberships, or checkout experiences.
Experience working on consumer platforms with multiple product verticals where shared experiences connect the ecosystem.
Familiarity with our stack and ecosystem: Python, Node, React, Postgres, Redis, Docker, AWS, and related tools.


At Super.com, we believe in supporting our team so they can thrive—both at work and in life.


Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world and choose the hours that suit you best. We trust you to get great work done on your terms.
Time to Recharge: Enjoy unlimited PTO, company-wide recharge days, and annual team offsites.
Everyday Perks: Weekly UberEats credits and travel discounts on Super.com help you enjoy the little things.
Family-Friendly Benefits: We support growing families with generous parental leave and a flexible return-to-work plan.
Comprehensive Compensation: Competitive salary, equity options, and top-tier benefits starting on day one.
Investing in You: Access to wellness budgets, personal development funds, and team-level learning resources.


And that’s just the beginning. Visit our careers page to explore the full range of perks and benefits we offer.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Informativ LLC offers credit report and compliance solutions to the automotive and general consumer finance industries across the United States. The Company optimizes and automates the consumer finance qualification process through a fast, easy-to-use, and secure software platform made available to its extensive network of software affiliate partners. Informativ’s products and solutions place a heavy emphasis on compliance and identity verification to support the credit application and credit report process. Please visit www.informativ.com for additional information.

**Position Description:**

As a Senior Software Engineer at Informativ, LLC you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our software applications. You will design and develop responsive and user-friendly web user interfaces. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products that meet customer needs and drive business growth. Your expertise will be essential in shaping the technical direction of our projects and mentoring junior team members.

**Responsibilities:**

*   Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to define software requirements and specifications.
*   Design, implement, and maintain scalable and efficient software solutions.
*   Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code.
*   Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
*   Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
*   Mentor and support junior engineers, fostering their growth and development.
*   Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies and apply them to our projects when relevant.
*   Participate in architectural and technical decision-making processes.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Remote, US)
description:
About the job

Why Openly

Openly is rebuilding insurance from the ground up. We are re-envisioning and enhancing every aspect of the customer experience. Doing this requires a rapidly growing team of exceptional, curious, empathetic people with a wide range of skill sets, spanning technology, data science, product, marketing, sales, service, claims handling, finance, etc.

The Openly Difference

We created Openly because we saw an evident gap in the market for premium insurance made simple. Consumers deserve more complete coverage at competitive prices.


The Price Difference: Using cutting-edge data and technology, we provide you with customizable, competitive prices to protect your most valuable assets. 
The Policy Difference: Coverages are truly customizable to meet your individual protection needs, for both standard coverages and optional add-ons. 
The Experience Difference: From tailored claims handling to highly responsive customer service, we are focused on making the home insurance purchasing process a better overall experience. 


Welcome to your next adventure.

At Openly, our people are just as important as our product. For us, collaboration, communication, and work-life balance are more than nice-to-haves— they’re the must-haves that make us who we are. We believe a great company is the result of a shared set of values, so we look for these qualities in every candidate we hire.


Integrity
Empathy
Teamwork
Curiosity
Urgency


We've designed our hiring process with you, the candidate, in mind. At every step, you have the chance to present your strengths and learn more about what makes Openly a great place to work.

We're committed to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

We embrace individuality and believe diverse teams are winning teams. Our commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, religion, identity, and experience drives us forward every day.

Job Details

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to be a technical leader on our data engineering team. This role involves designing and delivering robust, scalable data solutions for Openly's insurance platform. You will apply deep expertise across the data lifecycle—from architecture and pipeline design to optimization and mentoring—to shape how we build, manage, and access data for our products and business intelligence.

Key Responsibilities


Architect, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable data pipelines, data models, and data infrastructure across our GCP-based platform. 
Lead technical design decisions related to data architecture, pipeline orchestration, data modeling, and cloud infrastructure. 
Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and data transformations in BigQuery and PostgreSQL, ensuring performance, reliability, and correctness. 
Write production-grade code in Python and/or Go to build and enhance data management frameworks, services, and pipeline tooling. 
Partner with data science, business intelligence, product, and operations teams to translate business requirements into reliable data solutions. 
Own and improve the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for data projects: design, development, testing, CI/CD deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
Leverage streaming and event-driven architectures using Kafka (Aiven/Debezium) to build real-time data pipelines. 
Utilize and optimize distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark for large-scale data transformations. 
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level data engineers; conduct code reviews and promote engineering best practices. 
Share your knowledge within the data engineer team and the engineering organization through all-hands presentations, learning hours, domain meetings, and written documentation. 


Our stack


Backend/Core: Go & Postgresql
Frontend: Browser-based, VueJS, Vite, Webpack, Nuxt & Tailwind
Research/Data Science: R, ArcGIS, Vertex, & Python
Data: GCP GCS, BigQuery, Composer/Airflow, Cloud Functions, Postgres, SQL, Python, Aiven Debezium and Kafka, Fivetran
Infrastructure: Google Cloud, specifically Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and CloudSQL, managed with Terraform. We use GitHub for code hosting, DataDog and for monitoring, PagerDuty for on-call, and CircleCI for running our CI/CD pipelines. 
Remote work tools: Slack, Zoom


Requirements


4+ years of data engineering and data management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, production-grade data systems. 
Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL optimization — including query tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis, and data modeling in BigQuery and PostgreSQL. 
Expert-level scripting and programming in Python; experience with Go is a strong plus. 
Deep expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, GCS, Composer/Airflow, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and CloudSQL. 
Proven experience building and operating event-driven and streaming data pipelines using Kafka or similar technologies (Aiven/Debezium experience a plus). 
Strong understanding of modern data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures, including multi-layered data modeling patterns (bronze/silver/gold or equivalent). 
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience with Terraform to define, manage, and version cloud data infrastructure. 
Solid understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) best practices: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review processes, code repositories, and deployment management. 
Experience with data replication tools (e.g., Fivetran, Debezium) and understanding of CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns. 
Ability to independently drive data architecture decisions, translate business requirements into source-to-target data mappings, and deliver working, maintainable solutions. 
Strong communication skills; able to effectively collaborate with and educate both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives within a team environment. 


Nice to Have


Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or other distributed data processing frameworks for large-scale batch and/or streaming workloads. 
Familiarity with data observability and monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, Monte Carlo, Great Expectations). 
Prior experience in a regulated industry such as insurance, finance, or healthcare. 
Contributions to open-source data engineering projects or internal data platform tooling. 
Experience with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or equivalent


Compensation & Benefits:

Below is the budgeted salary range for this position. Actual compensation for this position will be determined based on the successful candidate's experience and skills. We are committed to providing a compensation package that not only reflects the responsibilities and requirements of the role, but also the unique expertise that the chosen candidate will bring to our team.

Budgeted Salary Range

$140,800—$158,400 USD

The full salary range shows the min to max salary range for this position. Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience and qualifications and determined based on various factors including the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Full Salary Range

$140,800—$211,200 USD

Benefits & Perks


Remote-First Culture - We supported #remotelife long before it was a given. We'll keep promoting it. 
Competitive Salary & Equity
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plan Offerings
Life and disability coverage including voluntary options

Annual Professional Development Fund: Each employee has $2,000 in professional development (PD) funds to spend on activities or resources annually. We want each Openly employee to achieve personal and professional success and to feel supported, confident, and informed about improving their efficiency and productivity. 
Be Well Program - Employees receive $50 per month to use towards your overall well-being
Paid Volunteer Service Hours
Referral Program and Reward

U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, and those authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer and currently residing in the US will be considered.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
_Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs._  
  
_We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there._  
  
_For more information, visit_ _arcadia.io_

### **Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia**

The Senior Product Manager plays a critical role in shaping and delivering products across Arcadia’s platform and data connectivity suite. This role owns a portfolio of capabilities that power how healthcare organizations access, trust, and activate data to improve outcomes and lower cost of care.

  
You will solve complex problems at the intersection of healthcare data, analytics, and real-world clinical workflows. You will translate business and customer needs into clear product strategy, measurable outcomes, and high-quality execution in close partnership with engineering, UX, data, and customer-facing teams.

  

This role directly supports Arcadia’s growth by:

  

*   Delivering differentiated platform capabilities that drive customer retention and expansion
*   Reducing time-to-value for new and existing customers
*   Ensuring our roadmap aligns to strategic company priorities and market opportunity
*   Balancing innovation with platform stability and scalability

  

**What Success Looks Like**

**In 3 months**

*   Develop a strong understanding of Arcadia’s platform architecture, product suite, and value propositions
*   Build trusted relationships with engineering, design, sales, operations, and customer-facing partners
*   Take ownership of one or more product areas and actively manage backlog prioritization
*   Participate in customer conversations to understand workflows, pain points, and strategic needs
*   Align roadmap priorities to clearly articulated business outcomes and OKRs

**In 6 months**

*   Deliver meaningful product enhancements or new capabilities that drive measurable customer value
*   Demonstrate strong ownership of roadmap execution and cross-functional coordination
*   Lead structured discovery efforts that inform strategic investment decisions
*   Establish clear product metrics and reporting to track adoption, impact, and performance
*   Facilitate trade-off conversations that balance customer needs, technical constraints, and long-term strategy

**In 12 months**

  

*   Be recognized as the clear product owner and subject matter expert for your portfolio
*   Drive roadmap strategy that supports both short-term revenue goals and long-term platform scalability

*   Launch significant new features or capabilities that improve customer satisfaction and retention
*   Proactively identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve performance, or unlock new value
*   Contribute to broader product strategy discussions and mentor more junior product team members

### **What You'll Be Doing**

*   Own product strategy and roadmap for defined areas of Arcadia’s platform
*   Translate business strategy and customer insights into clear product vision, requirements, and measurable outcomes
*   Lead discovery efforts including customer interviews, workflow analysis, and data-driven investigation
*   Develop business cases that quantify impact, trade-offs, and ROI
*   Partner closely with engineering and UX to define MVP scope and drive iterative delivery
*   Actively manage and prioritize backlogs based on impact, urgency, and strategic alignment
*   Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination
*   Communicate roadmap progress, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders
*   Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to ensure successful launches and customer adoption
*   Track and report on product performance metrics and continuously refine based on feedback and data
*   Advocate for both platform scalability and thoughtful technical debt management

### **What You'll Bring**

**Education**

  

*   Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus

  

  
**Experience**

  

*   5+ years of product management experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, or data platforms
*   Proven track record of launching and iterating on complex software products
*   Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile environments
*   Strong experience working with data-driven products; comfort using SQL or analytical tools to self-serve insights
*   Experience engaging directly with customers and translating feedback into actionable product decisions

  

**Qualities**

*   Strategic thinker who can connect detailed execution to long-term outcomes
*   Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity across teams
*   Strong ownership mindset and bias toward action
*   Collaborative leader who builds trust across disciplines
*   Calm and confident facilitator of trade-off discussions

  

  
**Skills**

  

*   Excellent written and verbal communication
*   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
*   Ability to break down complex requests into iterative, deliverable increments
*   Roadmap planning and prioritization
*   Familiarity with healthcare data standards, interoperability, or analytics platforms is a plus

### **Would Love For You To Have**

**Preferred Experience**

  

*   Experience with population health, value-based care, or healthcare interoperability
*   Exposure to AI/ML-enabled analytics or data-driven clinical insights
*   Experience working in high-growth SaaS environments

  

**Qualities**

  

*   Passion for improving healthcare outcomes through better data
*   Systems thinker who considers scalability and long-term sustainability

  

**Skills**

  

*   Advanced SQL or analytics experience
*   Experience working across platform or infrastructure product teams

### **What You'll Get**

*   The opportunity to shape products that meaningfully impact patient care and healthcare efficiency
*   Be a part of a mission driven company that is transforming the healthcare industry by changing the way patients receive care
*   A flexible, remote friendly company with personality and heart
*   Employee driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development
*   Become a member of the talented, energized, diverse and purpose-driven Arcadian Community

$144,300 - $210,000 a year

**About Arcadia**

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. title: Senior Engineer III - Billing Systems with verification
description:

Experience with different payment processors including Stripe, Braintree, Cybersource, or Paymentech.

This job doesn't have an expiration date and will remain open until a qualified candidate is hired.

title: Manager, Operation Technology and SCADA
description:
**ABOUT AVANTUS**

Avantus develops, owns, and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. Our development pipeline represents one of the nation's largest portfolios of solar with integrated storage, capable of providing dispatchable power to 17 million Americans, day and night. With over a decade of industry leadership and strategic investment from KKR and EIG, Avantus delivers affordable, reliable clean energy solutions that meet America's growing energy demand.

  

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized candidate for the Manager, Operational Technology and SCADA position. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound industry knowledge, superior communications, and detail-oriented organizational skills. This role reports to our Sr. Manager, Information Technology.

This role requires and experienced technology leader to own, scale and evolve the data acquisition layer that connects our utility‑scale solar and battery storage assets to all downstream consumers of operational data. The successful candidate is responsible for the systems that enable asset management, performance analytics, grid compliance, third‑party integrations, and executive reporting, serving as the critical bridge between project sites and the people and platforms that rely on their data.

The Manager of OT & SCADA will lead the design, procurement, deployment, and ongoing support of a secure, scalable communications architecture across a growing portfolio. This is a hands‑on, builder role that works closely with construction partners, utilities, grid operators, O&M providers, and equipment vendors to commission and integrate site‑level systems. As the portfolio grows, the role will evolve to include building and leading an OT team and contractor network.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*   Lead site integration and commissioning of OT and SCADA systems, including on-site deployment, configuration, validation, and documentation of edge devices, networks, and data points across utility-scale solar and BESS projects.

*   Design, implement, and maintain secure OT network architectures, including industrial firewalls, segmentation, DMZ's, and remote access in alignment with NERC CIP and internal IT security standards.

*   Own NERC CIP alignment and audit readings for OT and control system assets, coordinating with Asset Management, IT, Cybersecurity, and external compliance partners to implement controls, maintain evidence, and stay current with evolving standards.

*   Serve as the technical owner of OT data and vendor integrations, defining data scope, quality, frequency, and change management requirements while maintaining authoritative tag registers and documentation.

*   Provide asset management and commercial support, including PPA compliance, availability and curtailment validation, NERC GADS reporting support, settlements dispute resolution, and technical due diligence for asset acquisitions.

*   Act as the OT subject matter expert for operational incidents and cybersecurity events, leading or coordinating root cause analysis, remediation, and stakeholder escalation as needed.

*   Partner with Project Development and EPC teams during project design and contracting to review SCADA architectures, identify integration or data access risks, and ensure alignment with the company's hardware‑agnostic data ownership strategy before construction.

  

**REQUIRED** **SKILLS AND** **QUALIFICAT****IONS**

*   Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands‑on OT/SCADA experience.

*   7+ years of OT/SCADA or industrial systems integration experience in energy, utilities, or industrial automation, with utility‑scale solar and/or BESS required.

*   Hands‑on experience deploying hardware‑agnostic edge computing platforms for industrial data acquisition and protocol conversion.

*   Strong proficiency with industrial communication protocols used in power generation, including end‑to‑end device‑level troubleshooting.

*   Experience designing secure OT network architectures, including firewalls, segmentation, and remote access, with a security‑first mindset.

*   Working knowledge of NERC CIP requirements applicable to Generator Owners/Operators.

*   Comfortable with field work and travel, including on‑site commissioning and direct interaction with inverter, BESS, and tracker OEMs.

*   Experience reviewing SCADA, controls, and data system contract language across construction, procurement, and interconnection agreements.

*   Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to document systems clearly and present technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

Southern New Hampshire University is looking for an AVP of AI Engineering reporting to the Vice President of AI Engineering. As a senior engineering leader, you will oversee operational execution, technical quality, and delivery reliability across the AI Engineering organization. This is the role accountable for ensuring AI projects move from strategy to stable, maintainable production systems - on time and at quality.

You will combine people leadership, technical depth, and operational thoughtfulness. The AVP drives daily AI engineering execution, makes and guides technical decisions across the organization, and builds the operational practices and team culture that sustain high-quality delivery. This includes setting the standard for AI-augmented engineering - shaping how we adopt AI development tools and evolving our definition of engineering productivity.

You will work remotely from any of our approved states.

What You'll Do


You will lead operational delivery across AI Engineering: planning, staffing, execution, and shipment of projects
You will translate strategy into executable technical plans, milestones, and resourcing models
You will maintain visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery health
You will guide execution practices across teams (planning cadences, estimation, delivery reviews, retrospectives, postmortems)
You will ensure production readiness, on-call practices, and incident response processes are in place and improving
You will lead long-term sustainability of AI systems post-launch, including maintenance, monitoring, and ongoing optimization
You will be senior technical authority for AI Engineering and infrastructure decisions
You will guide architecture for agentic AI systems, data platforms, evaluation frameworks, and production services - with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, cost efficiency, and observability
You will establish organizational standards for agent orchestration, memory, and tool use patterns
You will lead cost governance for LLM-based systems (token economics, model selection tradeoffs)
You will define evaluation strategy for LLM and agent-based systems, ensuring measurable performance criteria exist before production deployment
You will partner with Staff and Principal Engineers across SNHU to establish and promote adherence to AI technical standards
You will directly manage engineering and senior technical leads
You will coach managers on delivery, performance, and team development
You will lead staffing, hiring, onboarding and career growth
You will foster a culture of accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement
You will partner across SNHU teams, including AI Governance, Product, Data Science, Design, IT, and Academic partners to ensure smooth execution
You will communicate delivery progress, tradeoffs, and constraints to senior leadership
You will help translate technical realities into applicable decisions for senior leadership
You will set expectations and create conditions for AI-augmented development across the organization: tooling decisions, workflow patterns, and evolving standards for how the team uses AI development tools


What We're Looking For


10+ years of software engineering experience, with time in production systems
5+ years leading engineering teams through managers or senior technical leads
Experience overseeing delivery for complex, multi-team technical projects
Expertise balancing technical depth with people and operational leadership
Experience in production software systems engineering
Experience building and operating AI-enabled systems in production environments
Experience with agentic AI architecture, LLM-based systems, and agent orchestration patterns
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), data pipelines, and system reliability
Experience with evaluation methodologies for LLMs and agentic systems (offline evals, human-in-the-loop, production monitoring)
Experience with AI development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)
Experience with complex architecture reviews, technical tradeoffs, and debugging when needed
Experience establishing engineering processes that improve predictability without bureaucracy
Familiarity with on-call models, incident response, and production operations
Experience improving engineering quality, delivery speed, and system stability

title: Engineering Manager - Sensor Alignment with verification
description:
About the job

Job Description

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and technically adept Engineering Manager – Sensor Alignment (Sensor Calibration) to lead core teams within the SEAM Embodied AI organization. This is a people leadership role with deep technical expectations. You will be instrumental in shaping the future of autonomous driving by setting the vision for, and leading, a dedicated team that owns the end‑to‑end sensor alignment and calibration stack powering GM’s Autonomous Vehicle (AV) platforms.

You will manage senior engineers and technical leads, set the technical direction for multi‑sensor calibration and state estimation systems, and partner closely with adjacent teams across Embodied AI and the broader AV organization. You will establish best practices for technical execution, grow technical leaders, and continue to build and uplevel a high‑impact team that directly influences on‑road performance, safety, and scalability of AV features.

About the Team:

The Sensor Alignment team builds and operates the systems that ensure every sensor on the vehicle—cameras, lidars, radars, IMUs, wheel encoders, and more—works together as a coherent, precisely calibrated perception and localization system.

The team owns: 


Factory alignment processes that ensure sensors are accurately mounted and calibrated at production time across GM’s vehicle portfolio. 
Onboard software and ML models for calibration and continuous alignment, enabling vehicles to monitor, detect, and correct misalignment over their lifetime. 
Offline calibration and refinement pipelines for data collected from fleets, feeding high‑quality, well‑aligned data into model training, validation, and AV development workflows. 
State estimation and localization interfaces that downstream perception, planning, and control stacks depend on. 
Data quality and validation criteria for calibration signals across the loop (onboard, offboard, and in simulation). 



We leverage principled approaches from robotics, estimation theory, machine learning, and optimization, paired with modern software engineering practices, to deliver robust, fault‑tolerant systems that run in real time on vehicles across GM’s large portfolio and at scale on data collection fleets and in the cloud.

Why Join Us? 


Own a critical safety lever: Sensor alignment directly impacts perception quality, localization accuracy, and ultimately the safety envelope of AV behavior. 
Scale cutting‑edge robotics systems: Build and evolve calibration and state estimation systems that run across large fleets, diverse platforms, and billions of miles of real‑world and simulated data. 
Shape AV autonomy capabilities: Partner with leading experts in state estimation, mapping, perception, and planning to define the next generation of onboard and offboard autonomy systems for L2, L3, and L4 applications. 
Lead a high‑impact, collaborative team: Work with a talented group of robotics, software, and systems engineers who care deeply about engineering rigor, safety, and shipping production systems. 



What You’ll Do:


Lead and grow the Sensor Alignment team: Manage an interdisciplinary group of senior engineers and technical leads responsible for state estimation and sensor calibration systems. 
Set and drive technical vision: Define the long‑term architecture and roadmap for onboard and offboard calibration, state estimation, and alignment infrastructure, in partnership with senior technical leaders across Embodied AI. 
Define project roadmaps and milestones for calibration, localization, and alignment capabilities. 
Prioritize initiatives that improve robustness, scalability, and safety‑critical performance across vehicle platforms and environments. 
Establish and enforce best practices for C++/Python development, testing, validation, and deployment in safety‑critical systems. 
Provide regular technical feedback, coaching, and mentorship to direct and indirect reports. 
Guide the design, implementation, and deployment of real‑time onboard calibration as well as offline and cloud‑based calibration pipelines. 
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and deeply observability‑driven, with clear metrics for performance and health. 
Foster exploration of new approaches to multi‑sensor self‑calibration, joint estimation of extrinsics/intrinsics, and robust fault detection/handling strategies. 
Encourage experimentation balanced with disciplined validation and safety considerations. 
Partner with perception, prediction, planning, mapping, hardware, and operations teams to ensure sensor alignment systems integrate seamlessly and meet product needs. 
Align with safety, validation, and operations teams on requirements, test strategies, and rollout plans. 
Promote a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performance culture aligned with GM’s engineering values. 
Help define processes for incident response, root‑cause analysis, and continuous improvement related to calibration and alignment issues. 



What You Must Have: 


BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. 
Proven experience managing and scaling high‑performing engineering teams in robotics, autonomy, or related domains. 
Demonstrated ability to inspire and motivate teams, drive best practices, and deliver continuous improvement in both technical execution and team health. 
Strong background in sensor calibration, state estimation, and/or localization (e.g., multi‑sensor fusion, SLAM, extrinsic/intrinsic calibration, pose graph optimization). 
Solid software engineering proficiency in C++ and Python, including experience with large codebases, performance optimization, and robust testing. 
Experience delivering production‑grade software systems in real‑time, safety‑critical or near safety‑critical environments. 
Demonstrated ability to balance long‑term architectural investments with near‑term feature delivery. 
History of establishing metrics, monitoring, and alerting for complex systems, and driving incident response and root‑cause analysis processes. 
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non‑technical stakeholders. 
Strong collaboration and influencing skills across organizations, including product, safety, validation, and hardware teams. 



Bonus Points: 


Experience in Autonomous Vehicles (AV) or ADAS systems, especially in perception, localization, mapping, or motion planning. 
Hands‑on experience with multi‑sensor calibration stacks (e.g., camera–lidar, camera–radar, lidar–IMU) and large‑scale deployment across fleets. 
Background in probabilistic robotics, estimation/filtering (e.g., EKF/UKF, factor graphs), or optimization‑based calibration and SLAM. 
Experience developing or working with safety‑critical software following rigorous validation, verification, and compliance processes. 
Familiarity with simulation and synthetic data for calibration, alignment, and validation workflows. 
Experience collaborating with or leading teams that build mapping, localization, or high‑definition map creation pipelines at scale. 



Remote: This role is based remotely but if you live within a 50-mile radius of Austin, Detroit, Warren, Milford or Mountain View, you are expected to report to that location three times per week, at minimum.

Compensation : The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area.

title: Solution Architect, Integration Partners (Remote)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

The Solution Architect, Alliance Partners is a technically elite, partner-obsessed professional who serves as the primary technical bridge between CrowdStrike and our Integration Partner ecosystem. You will drive the design, delivery, and enablement of integrations built on the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform — helping partners unlock its full potential while accelerating joint go-to-market success. At CrowdStrike, we're on a mission to stop breaches. This role directly advances that mission by expanding the Falcon Platform's reach through a world-class partner ecosystem. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise, cybersecurity, and strategic partnerships, this role is for you.

This role supports two distinct partner motions: Associate Tier integration partners and OEM/Embedded partners, each requiring a tailored technical engagement approach.

*   Associate Tier Partners — Focus on technical integration design, validation, enablement, and ongoing partner success with the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform.
    
*   OEM/Embedded Partners — Focus on Sales Engineering-style go-to-market support including technical demos, proof-of-value execution, and RFI/RFP responses.
    

_This is a remote position which can be performed anywhere in the US._

What You'll Do:

Associate Tier Partner Support

*   Design, build, and validate integrations between partner technologies and the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform against defined standards and best practices.
    
*   Work closely with Integration Partners, their Solution Architects, Sales Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering teams to promote and advance CrowdStrike's technical and business objectives.

*   Contribute technical content to the CrowdStrike partner portal and integration catalog.

OEM / Embedded Partner Support

*   Provide Sales Engineering support for OEM/Embedded partners including technical demos, proof-of-value (POV) execution, and RFI/RFP responses.
*   Engage with partner sales and technical teams to support joint selling motions and accelerate deal progression.

Enablement & Training

*   Provide inputs to the technical enablement team to build and improve training content for partners.
    
*   Serve as the technical liaison between internal CrowdStrike teams and partners to facilitate collaboration and remove blockers.
    
*   Participate in events such as security conferences, lunch & learns, and partner-sponsored events.
    

Operations & Innovation

*   Track and report on partner integration health, adoption metrics, escalation trends, and field activities.
    
*   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable, low-touch partner onboarding experiences through automation and tooling.
    
*   Identify and incorporate agentic AI solutions to improve integration workflows, partner enablement, and overall operational efficiency.
    

What You'll Need:

*   5+ years of technical experience in cybersecurity, solution architecture, or sales engineering.
    
*   Prior experience working in or with a partner, channel, or alliance ecosystem.
    
*   Experience in a security-focused solution architect or sales engineer role.
    
*   Demonstrated ability to manage multiple partner engagements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
    
*   Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage a variety of audiences including senior executives.
    
*   Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed, including CrowdStrike SKOs and major partner events.
    

Strong technical foundation in modern security platforms and at least several of the following domains:

*   Endpoint Defense
    
*   Modern Malware Lifecycle
    
*   Threat Intelligence
    
*   Security Operations & Incident Response
    
*   Endpoint Management
    
*   Cloud Security & Cloud Operations
    
*   SIEM, SOAR, or XDR platform integrations
    
*   Experience with one or more modern programming languages: Go, Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or equivalent.
    
*   Experience with data consumption capabilities including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhook-based integration patterns, scripting, MCP, and common data exchange formats (JSON, XML, etc.).
    
*   Proficiency in scripting languages including PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python.
    
*   Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate integration development and operational workflows.
    

Bonus Points:

The incumbent will serve as a liaison and subject matter expert to internal and external customers on Velera’s products and services. Product manager will handle efficiencies, monitor product compliance and mandates, analyze product penetration, define the market release process, manage initiatives related to transition from legacy tools to the target-state tool, and bridge the gaps between different functions within the company and aligning the strategic teams.

**Day in the Life:**

*   Lead the analysis and review product enhancement requests from various sources and oversee the creation of business requirements for these enhancements.

*   Identify risks throughout feasibility studies and development process and communicate issues to senior product management and leadership for evaluation; develop market test scenarios and ensure approval from the end-user for product rollout.
    
*   Development of product documentation, procedures, and training in all pertinent platforms.
    
*   Report and routinely update product and solution performance information.

*   Assist in the coordination and presentation of seminars and training for Velera personnel, prospective clients, trade associations, current members and other entities as assigned.
    
*   Conduct and lead meetings to support the development process and track and communicate progress.
    
*   Attend and participate in various Velera sponsored events and industry events, as needed.

description:

Department: Development

Who We Are

Impiricus is the first and only AI-powered HCP Engagement Engine. In 2025, Deloitte named Impiricus the #1 fastest growing company in North America for their prestigious Fast 500 list. Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was created to transform how life sciences companies support physicians. We ethically connect HCPs to pharma resources, reduce go-to-market costs and accelerate patient access to the treatments they need.

With our unique access to the largest opted-in network of HCPs, their insights, and clinical expertise, we are the leading provider of AI technology and real-time channels that life science companies need to deliver clear, reliable, and evidence-based resources directly into the hands of HCPs. Guided by a council of 2000+ trusted HCP advisors, we ensure every interaction is clinically meaningful, ethically grounded and leads to better patient care.

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer (Backend) Intern at Impiricus, you will support the development of backend systems and AI-powered features that power our digital healthcare platform. You will work alongside experienced engineers to build APIs, work with databases, and experiment with AI integrations that enhance our products.

This role is designed for students or recent graduates interested in backend development and applied AI. You will gain hands-on experience with modern backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and large language model (LLM) integrations while contributing to real product features used in healthcare.

Responsibilities


Assist in building and maintaining backend services and APIs that support core product features.
Work with PostgreSQL databases to help model data, write queries, and support reliable data pipelines.
Help integrate AI and LLM-based capabilities into backend workflows, including prompt development and API integrations.
Support the development of services that enable AI-powered features within our healthcare platform.
Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and designers to help deliver end-to-end features.
Write clean, well-documented, and tested code while learning backend engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, and system improvements with guidance from senior engineers.


Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related STEM field.
Familiarity with backend programming languages (preferrably Python or Golang).
Basic understanding of API development and RESTful services.
Exposure to relational databases and SQL, including writing queries and working with data models.
Interest in AI/LLMs and prompt engineering, with some coursework or personal projects involving AI tools or APIs.
Foundational understanding of machine learning or AI concepts.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Exposure to cloud platforms (preferably AWS) is a plus.


Compensation

This is a paid internship with an hourly rate of $25, with interns working up to 40 hours per week.

The program runs for 8 weeks and will be offered in two cohorts. Candidates may participate in the cohort that best aligns with their summer schedule.

Cohort 1: June 15, 2026 through August 7, 2026

Cohort 2: July 6, 2026 through August 28, 2026

Impiricus provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Technical Lead (Freelance)
description:
Instrument is a digitally native design and technology company built to help brands unlock their full potential. You’ll play a critical role in shaping backend architecture, extending Wagtail capabilities, and ensuring a smooth deployment pipeline on Google Cloud.

## **Pay Range**

title: PRODUCT MANAGER - Client Experience
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION:** Product Manager – Partner Integrations  
**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt  
JOB SUMMARY  
  
The Product Manager is responsible for the product ideation, planning, and execution across the full lifecycle of the benefits administration ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in the benefits administration industry or equivalent benefits experience, a comprehensive understanding of the platform’s end-to-end capabilities, and hands-on experience delivering solutions for clients. The Product Manager will collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments and external third parties — including Implementation, Client Services, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Sales — to ensure the product meets market needs, drives client satisfaction, and supports the company’s strategic goals.  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  
  

*   Define/qualify/roadmap
*   Lead and evolve the product strategy and Leverage industry knowledge to identify trends, regulatory changes, and competitive dynamics that inform product direction, and provide ultimate accountability to product outcomes.
*   Translate client feedback, platform usage data, and stakeholder input into actionable product enhancements.
*   Synthesize business-level product objectives utilizing multiple sources of input and clarify and refine the objectives to actionable technical problem statements with product ownership and engineering leaders.
*   Create and deliver Market Requirement Document (MRD)/Business Case: market need/problem statement, customer journey (employer, employee and broker/channel partner), market segment best suited, along with investment and ROI models that support the product or product enhancement
*   roadmap for the Benefits Administration platform, aligning with business goals, client needs, and operational scalability.

*   Go to market
*   Partner with marketing to support the development and refresh external materials and messaging.
*   Partner with sales and account management resources to develop deal-specific strategies and inform the optimal positioning and packaging of products in a way that best suits the customer’s strategy. Represent aligned products as a SME on request in sales or customer presentations.
*   Go to deploy/operations
*   Collaborate with internal departments and external third parties to develop and formalize deployment strategy, timeline, and change management plans
*   Support client delivery teams with product expertise during onboarding, renewals, and escalations.
*   Drive internal education and enablement for new product releases, including training materials, documentation, and rollout plans.

*   Product performance
