*   OR, a Master's degree: Five (5) years of relevant experience.
*   OR fifteen (15) or more years of relevant education and/or relevant experience may be considered to satisfy educational and years-of-experience requirements for this posting.

**_Preferred Qualifications:_**

*   APICS Certifications
*   Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
*   Professional registration as a professional engineer
*   Current or previous certification in Earned Value Management systems (EVMS), including experience with successful implementation and maintenance of EVMS to help manage a project/program.

title: BIM Manager
description:
**Location: Remote**

## **The Role: BIM Manager**

As the BIM Manager at Switch, you own the development and integrity of our Mechanical and Plumbing Revit environment. You ensure our models, templates, and content meet Switch standards and support design, construction, product development, and digital twin workflows. This role connects project execution with long-term BIM standards, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and usable data across teams. You act as the technical lead for BIM content and model governance.

## **What You’ll Do**

*   Create and maintain Switch Mechanical and Plumbing Revit template models used across projects
    
*   Translate Product Development SolidWorks content into accurate, usable Revit counterparts
    
*   Create, update, and govern proprietary Revit families within the Switch BIM Content Library
    
*   Ensure Revit content includes required parametric data and metadata to support downstream workflows
    
*   Provide milestone-based Revit model updates to the Digital Twin team
    
*   Advise on BIM requirements within BEPs, EIRs, RFPs, and project scope documentation
    
*   Capture workflow gaps from project teams and recommend improvements to the BIM Director
    
*   Coordinate BIM support needs across active projects and align coverage with project milestones
    
*   Ensure final BIM and drawing deliverables are compliant and submitted to the Document Control team for Data Center Library integration
    
*   Support internal conceptual modeling efforts for new designs and innovation initiatives

*   Operates with precision in mission-critical environments
    
*   Communicates requirements clearly and directly

**Required**

*   7–10 years of experience working in BIM, with strong focus on Revit for MEP systems
    
*   Experience building and managing Revit templates and custom families
    
*   Working knowledge of BIM execution plans and project documentation standards
    
*   Experience coordinating BIM workflows across design and construction teams
    
*   Strong understanding of parametric modeling and structured data within Revit
    

**Preferred**

*   Experience translating SolidWorks models into Revit environments
    
*   Experience supporting digital twin or facilities lifecycle workflows
    
*   Familiarity with large-scale, mission-critical, or data center projects
    

If you meet most of the qualifications and can perform the core responsibilities, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Principal Security Architect
description:
If you're passionate about shaping the future of secure AI, cloud, and engineering at scale, this is your opportunity. Strategic Education Inc. (SEI)—a mission‑driven leader in workforce‑aligned education—is seeking a Senior Principal Security Architect to help build what’s next. SEI empowers working adult learners through flexible, affordable, career‑relevant education across brands like Strayer University, Capella University, Sophia Learning, and Workforce Edge. This is not a maintenance role—it’s a chance to define the security foundation of an organization committed to expanding access and innovating at scale.  
  
As SEI’s Senior Principal Security Architect, you’ll serve as the top technical authority for security architecture across AI, cloud, applications, and data platforms. This influential, hands‑on role partners directly with the CISO and senior engineering leaders to design secure AI/ML systems, architect multi‑cloud environments, drive DevSecOps transformation, and embed secure‑by‑design principles across modern engineering ecosystems. You’ll translate strategy into practical patterns, guide high‑impact enterprise initiatives, mentor teams, and strengthen the resilience and trustworthiness of the platforms powering SEI’s global learning experience.

**What You’ll Do**

**Architect Secure Cloud & AI Platforms**

*   Design end‑to‑end security architecture for AI/ML systems, multi‑cloud infrastructure, and modern application ecosystems.
*   Build secure design patterns for APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and serverless workloads.
*   Define cloud and application security standards for engineering and platform teams.
*   Lead architecture reviews and guide critical initiatives across cloud and AI environments.

**Secure AI & Machine Learning Systems**

*   Implement advanced controls for ML pipelines and generative AI platforms.
*   Identify and mitigate risks such as prompt injection, model poisoning, AI supply chain vulnerabilities, and data leakage.
*   Partner with data science teams to ensure secure training, deployment, and governance of AI models.
*   Champion secure and responsible AI adoption throughout the enterprise.

**Lead Cloud Security Architecture**

*   Architect secure solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
*   Define identity, segmentation, encryption, workload protection, and observability patterns.
*   Secure Kubernetes, containers, and serverless workloads at scale.
*   Build guardrails that empower engineering teams to innovate safely.

**Enable DevSecOps at Scale**

*   Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines and the full SDLC.
*   Deploy and optimize automated tools for SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, and container security.
*   Drive shift‑left practices and foster engineering‑led security adoption.

**Risk Management & Governance**

*   Align architecture with frameworks like NIST RMF, SOC, SOX, and zero‑trust principles.
*   Guide risk assessments, compliance efforts, and enterprise control design.
*   Ensure secure‑by‑design principles are consistently embedded into systems and processes.

**Collaboration, Influence & Culture**

*   Partner with engineering, cloud, product, IT, and business leaders to deliver secure solutions.
*   Influence decisions across executive and technical stakeholders.
*   Mentor and develop security engineers and architects.
*   Foster a security‑first, innovation‑driven culture.

**Required Qualifications**

*   **10+ years of professional experience** in information security spanning multiple domains, including cloud, application, and platform security.
*   **Proven experience designing and implementing large‑scale enterprise security architectures** across modern engineering and cloud environments.
*   **Deep technical expertise** in cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern application architectures (APIs, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless).
*   **Hands‑on experience or strong foundational understanding of AI/ML security** , including risks such as data leakage, model manipulation, and supply chain vulnerabilities.
*   **Strong ability to influence and collaborate** with senior leaders, engineering teams, cloud operations, and cross‑functional stakeholders.
*   **Demonstrated capability to translate complex technical risks into clear business impact** for executive audiences.
*   **Exceptional architectural thinking, communication, and strategic problem‑solving skills.**
*   **Experience mentoring and developing security engineers** , helping foster a high‑performance, security‑first engineering culture.

**Preferred Qualifications**

*   Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
*   Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
*   Or other similar industry‑recognized security certification

description:

Monitoring competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, or other information that may affect market share. title: Implementation Specialist - PrivacyPro
description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

  
Bluesight is seeking a passionate project manager to run the implementation of PrivacyPro for new customers. This person is responsible for forming relationships with clinicians, privacy and compliance teams and end users of Bluesight's products and ensuring our clients have the best possible implementation experience. This position is a key member of the implementation team and is responsible for scheduling project milestones, hosting kick-off & follow-up calls, and training end users on our products & services.

The ideal candidate has a high attention to detail, loves to talk to people of different backgrounds, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

*   Manage all aspects of the PrivacyPro implementation projects; including the project kick off, software configuration, go live and training while maintaining project timelines.
*   Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live and own all communications with the customer including weekly check in meetings via Zoom, ad hoc meetings, emails, etc.
*   Manage multiple implementation projects, with various priorities and deadlines at once for different customers.
*   Work as a consultative partner with your customers to provide guidance on best configuration practices based on their workflows and internal processes.
*   Act as a liaison between the customer’s IT group and our internal Data Analysts, Product and Dev teams to facilitate the technical configuration of the software.
*   Maintain up to date project plans, tickets and other project documentation to ensure project timelines are on track and visible to leadership.
*   Work closely with the product team and other internal teams to provide customer feedback which will help define future enhancements to our products

### **Qualifications & Skills**

*   Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
*   5+ years of professional work experience, client facing and/or experience in the healthcare industry a plus
*   2+ years of project management; preferably new customer implementations for a SaaS based software product
*   Experience running mid-long term projects, lasting 60 - 120 days
*   Hands on experience with project management software including JIRA, Excel, G Suite, and/or Salesforce preferred
*   Previous experience with SQL queries and/or running reports for EPIC, Cerner, Omnicell, Pyxis software a plus
*   High attention to detail and extremely organized
*   Excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal skills
*   Ability to adapt to change, think critically, and work independently/remotely
*   A positive team-player attitude who is committed to getting things done
*   Must be flexible with scheduling to work with customers in different time zones
*   Willingness to travel up to 15%

_This is the standard base pay range for this role. In addition to a base salary this position is also eligible for an amazing benefits package. Actual amount of salary will vary depending on position offered, experience, performance, and location._

**This position is a remote position and open to applicants in the continental United States.**

**  
Why Bluesight?**

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Description – Business Development Executive  
  
**Division / Department:**  Channel Sales  
**Reports to (position):**  Regional Sales Manager  
**Level / Grade:**  Individual Contributor  
**Location:**  Assigned territory  
**Employment Type:**  Full Time, Exempt  
**Work Conditions:**  Remote  
**Travel:**  Up to 40%  
**Telecommute:**  This is a remote position performing work in assigned territory  
**Minimum Educational Req:**  Four-year college degree in the area of Business Administration, Sales, Marketing or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience  
**Years of Experience:**  5-7 years in sales and/or channel sales.  
  
**Position Summary:**  
The Business Development Executive is responsible for all activities related to increasing revenue growth within their assigned geographic territory. Revenue generation will come from the management of an existing account base of strategic education clients, development of new client relationships, and through targeted marketing initiatives to drive awareness of The CE Shop as the premier real estate school in the territory. This position will work with management level decision makers and influencers and must exhibit a high level of industry knowledge within the association, brokerage, and school sales channels. The Business Development Executive must be excellent at building and sustaining relationships to drive and sustain strategic sales and marketing processes through the client base to meet business objectives.  
  
**Essential Functions / Job Responsibilities:**  

*   Achieve sales quota and assigned strategic objectives; represent the entire range of company products and services to increase sales revenue and market share. Substantial prospecting for new opportunities both within the existing client base and prospective targets is essential. This includes identifying target potential through its size, product needs, and buying cycles. This due diligence will lead to expanding current and new relationships whereby the client considers The CE Shop their valued partner and trusted source for real estate education.
*   Develop and implement strategic account proposals and presentations that creatively and accurately articulate the various programs offered by The CE Shop. Work with client leadership to map, build and implement sales and marketing processes that can be effectively managed and sustained to support the full network of agents and brokers within the organization.
*   Exhibit, attend and present at events/meetings held and managed by broker, association, and school partners in support of established sales and marketing strategies and to build awareness and engagement of The CE Shop brand and products to increase revenue.
*   Engage in marketing initiatives to maximize exposure and access to The CE Shop for real estate agents and prospective agents within the territory. Attend industry events, identify strategic advertising and partnership opportunities, and maintain effective access to collateral through the defined network of clients.
*   Develop a working knowledge of competitive products, programs, and pricing structures; analyze sales and industry trends and make appropriate recommendations to internal stakeholders to ensure long-range planning needs are met and relationships are established.

**Minimum Requirements:**  

*   Proven experience in creating (prospecting, selling, closing, managing) strategic client relationship.
*   Experience in working with key decision makers and industry influencers resulting in successful channel penetration and increased market share.
*   Experience developing and implementing sales and service processes and supporting metrics through sales data collection and analysis
*   Proven effectiveness of establishing and maintaining strong relationships resulting in collaborative strategies to drive growth
*   Experience in, and working knowledge of, real estate industry needs and trends that support agents, brokerages, trade associations, and real estate schools preferred

**Skills Required:**  

*   Ability to influence and persuade others to achieve desired outcomes
*   Strong analytic, problem solving, and negotiation skills
*   Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills
*   Excellent organizational, planning, and prioritization skills
*   Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Feels at home visiting clients on a daily basis
*   Ability to work with minimal supervision and excellent attention to detail

**Technical Skills Required:**  

*   Proficiency in MS Office Suite of products (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
*   Google platform (Google Docs, Google Mail, Google Calendar, Google Hangout, Google Analytics)
*   Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM Software
*   Experience with video conferencing (Zoom, GoToMeeting, etc.) and general A/V knowledge to effectively present to clients on site
*   Comfortable with learning and adapting to new technologies

**Supervisory Responsibility:**  
This position does not supervise the work of others.  
  
**Internal and external interaction:**  
This position interacts with peers both in and out of department and their immediate manager on a regular basis. They interact with customers directly in daily interactions as well as escalation or support situations in a defined geographical area. They may interact with managers in other departments and vendors.  
  
**Physical Requirements:**  
The physical demands of this position are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  
  
Salary $70,000-$75,000 plus 35% commission

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About the Position**

  
The Principal, Consultant is a senior-level technical leader responsible for delivering complex, multi-discipline projects and serving as a trusted subject matter expert within your discipline. You may serve as the Project Lead on selected projects, where you’ll be accountable for delivering work profitably, maintaining alignment with scope, and evaluating project health regularly to identify risks early and keep work on track.

  
You’ll lead discipline-specific design efforts, elevate quality, and ensure coordinated, high-performance project delivery across teams. You’ll document client-specific processes and deviations from TEECOM standards to support onboarding, delegation, and consistent delivery.

  
You’ll strengthen TEECOM’s foundations by modeling best practices, contributing to discipline documentation, authoring Pull Requests, and supporting improvements to tools, standards, and workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with Group Leads, Team Leads to ensure consistent application of standards and to resolve challenges.

  
Externally, you’ll cultivate strong client relationships—serving as a trusted technical advisor through clear communication, reliable execution, and sound engineering judgment. You’ll also contribute to pursuits and interviews, shape technical narratives, and participate in client discussions that strengthen TEECOM’s credibility and help win strategic work. Internally, you’ll mentor engineers and production team members by providing technical guidance, design reviews, and actionable feedback that improves project outcomes and supports their growth. While not a people manager, you play a key role in developing TEECOM’s capability and strengthening discipline excellence.

  
This position reflects strong technical expertise, reliable project leadership, disciplined execution, and a commitment to strengthening TEECOM’s standards, systems, and delivery.

### **Technical Leadership, Mentorship, and Improving the TEECOM System**

*   As a Principal, Consultant, your impact comes from strong technical leadership, supporting the development of others, and contributing to improvements in TEECOM’s systems and discipline practices. You contribute in three key ways:

**Technical Leadership**

*   You elevate project outcomes by leading technical decisions and ensuring design quality, coordination, and documentation meet TEECOM’s standards.
*   You guide Designers, engineers, and production team members by providing clear rationale, helping them navigate design challenges, and reinforcing disciplined workflows.
*   You build trust with clients through clear communication, reliable follow-through, and a strong command of your discipline.

**Mentor and Support Engineers**

*   You strengthen project teams by coaching engineers and Designers, developing their judgment, and helping them improve design clarity and documentation quality.
*   When serving as a Mentor, you broaden your mentee’s experience by involving them in client conversations, site walks, design reviews, and documentation discussions.
*   You accelerate their growth by setting clear expectations, delegating meaningful work, and providing timely, constructive feedback—including through participation in quarterly performance assessments.

**Improve the TEECOM System**

*   You reinforce firmwide consistency by contributing to discipline standards, templates, and documentation through clear, well-organized Pull Requests.
*   You identify workflow or coordination gaps and propose improvements that enhance clarity, efficiency, and scalability.
*   You capture client nuances, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen onboarding, delegation, and cross-team alignment.

### **What Success in this Position Looks Like**

*   You deliver coordinated, accurate, and well-documented discipline-specific and multi-discipline work on time, on budget, and to TEECOM’s quality standards.
*   You identify risks early, communicate them clearly, and make sound decisions that minimize rework and maintain project momentum.
*   You maintain strong utilization and contribute to financially successful projects within the scope and expectations set by the Project Lead or Group Lead.
*   You keep project documentation complete, accurate, and current—including design decisions, meeting notes, scope clarifications, and updates to the Design Decision Log (DDL).
*   You build client trust through clear communication and reliable follow-through, supporting pursuits by providing scope input, drafting or refining discipline fee proposals, and participating in interviews when needed.
*   You actively participate in client relationship development through networking events and conferences, direct outreach to clients and partners, and sharing intel gathered through documented interactions.
*   You strengthen TEECOM’s system by offering constructive feedback on templates, tools, and workflows and by contributing targeted Pull Requests that improve clarity and consistency.
*   You mentor Designers, engineers, and production team members through hands-on guidance, markups, and feedback that build judgment and strong documentation habits.
*   When paired as a Mentor, you meet regularly with your mentee, involve them in meaningful project activities, delegate with clear expectations, and contribute performance input to support their development.
*   You contribute to team and discipline knowledge through design reviews, internal discussions, and sharing lessons learned.
*   You stay current with industry trends and manufacturer updates and share relevant insights with your teams.
*   You collaborate effectively with Project Leads, Group Leads, and cross-discipline teammates to resolve coordination issues and support high-quality delivery.
*   You model TEECOM’s Core Values—Care, Trust, and Value—through communication, documentation, teamwork, and technical execution.
*   You are recognized by your teams as a reliable contributor whose work elevates design quality and project outcomes.

### **Responsibilities and Expectations**

*   These responsibilities and expectations represent what is required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

**Annual and Quarterly**

*   Partner with Project Leads, Group Leads, and Team Leads to strengthen delivery consistency, coordination strategy, and discipline standards across projects.
*   Maintain visibility into project financial performance, scope alignment, and delivery health—identifying risks early and recommending adjustments that protect profitability and predictable outcomes.
*   Contribute to annual business planning by identifying client needs, emerging opportunities, and discipline trends that inform TEECOM’s strategy.
*   Support client relationship development through business reviews, strategic discussions, and participation in pursuits that strengthen long-term partnerships.
*   Lead or contribute to technical design reviews and QA/QC efforts that reinforce TEECOM standards, documentation clarity, and coordinated delivery.
*   Strengthen TEECOM’s system through targeted Pull Requests, documentation updates, and captured lessons learned that improve discipline workflows and scalability.
*   Collaborate on workload forecasting, resource planning, and delivery standards that support cross-team alignment and delivery predictability.
*   Contribute to discipline knowledge-sharing through training sessions, internal workshops, conferences, or TEECOM University participation.
*   When serving as a Mentor, provide structured performance input and development guidance that strengthens technical growth and leadership readiness.

**Monthly and Biweekly**

*   Lead discipline design, coordination, and documentation efforts—ensuring alignment with TEECOM standards, client expectations, and project objectives.
*   Maintain visibility into project schedules, staffing assumptions, and scope alignment—adjusting plans as needed to protect quality, profitability, and delivery momentum.
*   Lead or participate in key client and coordination meetings, documenting critical decisions, risks, and deviations in the Design Decision Log (DDL) and project tools.
*   Conduct or contribute to design reviews and QA/QC efforts that reinforce coordination integrity and technical excellence.
*   Advance discipline standards and workflows through targeted Pull Requests and documentation updates that improve clarity and onboarding consistency.
*   Support pursuits by refining discipline scope assumptions, technical strategies, and fee inputs to align with delivery realities.
*   Maintain financial accountability by supporting billing clarity, scope validation, AR follow-up, and accurate time and expense reporting.
*   When serving as a Mentor, delegate meaningful responsibility, provide structured feedback, and reinforce technical judgment and documentation discipline.

**Weekly and Daily**

*   Maintain alignment across projects by participating in coordination, client, and internal team meetings—clarifying priorities, surfacing risks early, and supporting forward momentum.
*   Lead technical guidance through design reviews, markups, and real-time feedback that strengthen coordination, documentation clarity, and delivery quality.
*   Maintain disciplined documentation across GitHub, Asana, Callback One, and the Design Decision Log (DDL)—ensuring decisions, client nuances, and coordination outcomes remain clear and traceable.
*   Support pursuits and active project work by refining scope assumptions, design strategies, and technical direction that align with TEECOM standards and client expectations.
*   Communicate proactively with clients, design partners, and contractors to resolve issues, maintain alignment, and keep projects moving forward.
*   Monitor project health—including scope alignment, schedules, deliverable quality, and coordination readiness—and recommend adjustments when risks emerge.
*   Execute discipline design, coordination, and technical decision-making with strong judgment while reinforcing TEECOM workflows and documentation practices.
*   Maintain accurate time, expense, and project updates that support forecasting, billing, and delivery visibility.

**As Needed**

*   Support Additional Service Agreements (ASAs), scope adjustments, and proposal development to maintain alignment between delivery realities and contractual expectations.
*   Strengthen client relationships by participating in strategic discussions, industry events, and outreach that supports long-term partnerships and future opportunities.
*   Contribute to recruiting, mentoring, and team development through interviews, coaching, and participation in internal initiatives that strengthen TEECOM’s discipline capability.
*   Conduct site visits, field verifications, and programming sessions as required, documenting findings clearly to support coordinated delivery.
*   Contribute to TEECOM’s thought leadership and marketing efforts by sharing technical insights, lessons learned, or project-based content.
*   Support cross-team delivery during high-demand periods or complex project phases to maintain firmwide alignment and momentum.

### **Supervisory / Mentorship / Training Responsibilities**

*   **Supervisory**: When serving as a Mentor, you provide structured coaching and quarterly performance feedback for assigned mentees. You support discipline execution across projects by aligning Designers, engineers, and production team members with priorities, scope, and TEECOM standards, while surfacing dependencies, risks, and resourcing needs to Project Leads, Group Leads, or Team Leads for broader action.
*   **Mentorship**: Provide advanced technical guidance and design direction to Designers, engineers, and production team members. When paired as a Mentor, you broaden your mentee’s experience through design reviews, client discussions, and complex coordination challenges, reinforcing strong engineering judgment, documentation habits, and disciplined workflows.
*   **Training**: Contribute to discipline training by sharing lessons learned, participating in internal reviews, and supporting the development of training resources that improve technical consistency and delivery quality across teams.

### **Experience and Qualifications**

*   **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical preferred), Architecture, or a related field; or equivalent technical experience.
*   **Experience**: 8+ years of experience in AEC or related professional services with strong discipline-specific capability. (ICT, Security, Physical Security, Electronic Security)
*   Demonstrated experience delivering coordinated, high-quality designs and making sound decisions within your discipline.
*   Ability to lead discipline-specific portions of complex, multi-stakeholder projects with minimal oversight.
*   Strong understanding of project delivery workflows, client expectations, documentation standards, and coordination requirements.
*   Experience contributing to documentation updates, design standards, and QA/QC workflows through GitHub or similar platforms.
*   Proficiency in Autodesk (AutoCAD, Revit), Bluebeam Studio, Microsoft 365 Suite, Google Workspace, and GitHub.

**Industry certifications preferred by discipline:**

*   PSP and/or CPP (Security) — preferred
*   CDT — preferred

*   EIT — plus
*   PE — plus
*   PMP — plus

### **Physical Demands**

*   These physical demands represent what is required to perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.
*   Prolonged desk work using a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone.
*   Regular reading, writing, and communication in virtual and in-person settings.
*   Occasional travel to client sites for meetings, surveys, or inspections.
*   Site walks may require standing or walking for extended periods, climbing stairs, and navigating construction or utility areas.
*   Field activities may involve bending, kneeling, or maneuvering in confined spaces.
*   May occasionally lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

### **Work Environment**

*   These work environment characteristics represent the conditions encountered while performing essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.
*   Approximately 75% of work is performed in a remote or office environment using standard office equipment.
*   Approximately 25% occurs at client sites, including construction environments and existing facilities.
*   Construction sites may include exposure to elevated noise levels, dust, uneven or unfinished walking surfaces, variable lighting conditions, and active construction operations.
*   Utility rooms and similar spaces may have restricted access or may not fully comply with ADA accessibility standards. When access limitations exist, TEECOM will support coordinating reasonable accommodations with site-controlling contractor or alternative means to perform essential job functions.
*   All accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions must be reported immediately to the site superintendent and internally to People Operations.

TEECOM is committed to making sure that we are the right fit for each applicant and that each applicant is the right fit for our team. TEECOM offers a comprehensive benefits package to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their dependents, basic and voluntary life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with profit-sharing contributions, paid parental leave, lifestyle and legal benefits, pet benefits, and performance-based bonuses. Full-time exempt team members also enjoy flexible time off, and all employees receive nine scheduled paid holidays.

title: Customer Relations Coordinator
description:
**Customer Relations Coordinator (Bilingual English/Spanish)**

**Department:** Operations

**Supervisor:** Manager, Customer Relations

**Status:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time, Temporary for 6 months

**Location:** Remote

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

**Travel:** 0-1x/year

**Pay Range:** $24.20-$28.28/hour

**EEO Category:** Administrative Support Workers

**Position Summary:** The Customer Relations Coordinator serves as a first point of contact for incoming phone, email, and web chat communications from IFM customers, which include patients, practitioners, students, industry contacts, partners and other members of the functional medicine ecosystem. Working as part of a team, the Customer Relations Coordinator role is responsible for ensuring that all customers receive prompt and quality service. The Customer Relations Coordinator is responsible for upholding the IFM Employee Core Values when communicating with customers and ensures that customers receive prompt and correct responses. The Customer Relations Coordinator will answer the customer’s question(s) succinctly and with clarity, utilizing available internal resources (website, SOPs, templates etc.), escalating according to procedures/polices as required.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

*   Respond to customer inquiries by phone, email and chat, resolving issues with expertise and care; Answering customer inquiries according to response priority as defined in Customer Relations training expectations.
*   Process transactions for conferences and products available on our website, accurately applying discount codes as appropriate.
*   Deeply understand IFM’s offerings across education, certification and partnerships, learning platforms (e.g., LMS), and product features to guide user journeys and recommend relevant courses, certification offerings, or membership aligned with customer goals.
*   Responsible for learning and being aware of all Customer Relations & IFM policies, FAQs and any other relevant organizational information.
*   Respond to and receive all external communications through Customer Relations team inbox.
*   Document customer details in database in real time while following privacy policies, to ensure accurate record keeping and reporting.
*   Maintain daily phone, chat, and email tickets in database, documenting information on customer inquiries with a high level of accuracy.
*   Troubleshoot basic customer technical account issues.
*   Maintain accurate documentation and follow-up or escalate according to procedures/polices as required to ensure full resolution of issues and customer satisfaction.
*   Identify the root cause of customer issues and spot trends to proactively improve their success.
*   Recommend updates and creation of internal SOPs for new and/or revised systems or processes, common questions and responses and new program/pricing information as needed.
*   Identify gaps in processes, use innovation to resolve gaps, and execute the necessary resolutions.

Vice President Rail and Transit Leader

Parsons is looking for a Rail and Transit Leader to join our team! The Rail and Transit Leader (RTL) focuses on the identification, capture, and execution of work for key clients. Parsons Infrastructure comprises a team of engineers and technicians in the fields of civil (highways, rail, transit and aviation disciplines), structural (bridges and tunnels), geotechnical, electrical and mechanical engineering, and includes design, condition inspection, and construction management/construction inspection staff.

The RTL is also accountable for refining business strategy, growth, profit and loss performance, talent management, and oversight of the operations including directing and managing large/complex projects. The RTL must be an effective “seller/doer”, able to balance operational management, business development, and project management responsibilities. The RTL must also be a creative and innovative leader, able to communicate a vision and inspire others and effectively mentor and develop individual and team talent. Willingness to travel to the various offices and to client or project site locations may be required. The RTL will work with business and technical leadership to continue the legacy of technical and management excellence while growing a successful and sustainable business practice that fosters a challenging and fun workplace.

*   Create a high-performance culture:

Business Development/Growth Responsibilities:

Other responsibilities:

*   Drives growth while managing efficiency in short and long term.

*   Serves as a strong leader, fostering a culture of accountability, rewards, and consequences.
    
*   Focus on growth and development of staff and the practice.
    
*   Achieves maximum productivity by implementing best practices for utilizing communication technology, automation, and various software applications.
    
*   Demonstrates excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to make effective presentations to senior management and clients.
    
*   Possesses experience managing/overseeing large ($100MM+ construction value) rail, systems, bridge or highway projects.
    
*   Supports the overall success of the company by being a strong collaborator with other business units and geographies
    
*   Consistently exercises and demonstrates a sound Business Acumen.

title: Product Owner - Cloud/Pipeline Team
description:
Overview/ Job Responsibilities:

Sev1Tech is looking for a Product Owner/Project Manager for the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Ordnance Information System (OIS) program to provide technical expertise on a mission-critical program whose purpose is to develop, modernize, enhance, operate, and maintain services for OIS mission critical systems.

  

This role will be a key leadership role for the OIS Platform Team, leading solutions for the OIS AWS GovCloud Environment and DevSecOps (DSO) Pipeline Team. Your primary goal will be to provide vision and guidance for keeping each team on task in fulfilling their day-to-day responsibilities and meeting short/long term OIS product improvement goals.

  
This role requires a strong mix of customer service skills and a detailed technical understanding of the domains supported by the team to define user stories, incorporate features into the backlog, and develop the roadmap in collaboration with the technical leads. This role must be able to effectively translate general business needs/ConOps defined by OIS stakeholders and customers into user stories that are well understood by the technical team.

*     
    _This position can be performed remotely; however, travel to customer site in Mechanicsburg, PA, and other locations will be required occasionally (~10% travel)._

**Primary Responsibilities:** As Product Owner/Project Manager, you will:

*   Engage multiple roles and stakeholders in critical discussion, complex new product development discovery and building consensus
*   Act as a product owner to maximize ROI and meet the organization objectives such as defining vision, managing product backlog, overseeing development stages, anticipating client's needs, evaluating product progress at each iteration, etc.
*   Help identify and mitigate any external dependency risks in feature/product development
*   Work with clients and end users to gather, understand, and define business requirements
*   Develop user stories and to-be process flows to support the design and development of cloud and pipeline solutions
*   Work collaboratively with team members to design, test, and verify solutions that will meet business requirements and fulfill user stories
*   Participate in key meetings with clients including requirement sessions, system demos, user acceptance testing, and end user training
*   Participate in sprint planning meetings and ongoing refinement of the product backlog.
*   Leverage knowledge of assigned applications and customer needs to collaborate with the team to establish the portfolio backlog and roadmap.
*   Act as the voice of the customer when the government product owner is unavailable to facilitate understanding of the user stories by the agile product teams.
*   Coordinate with communication and training team members to ensure communication and training materials reflect the business needs being addressed by a change.
*   Manage risks, issues, change control and decision logs for the OIS Platform team
*   Communicate and manage project status to the executive level, to include resource allocation/needs and tracking against key milestones and timelines
*   Leverage stakeholder relationships and technical expertise to enable or make key decisions
*   Identify strategic milestones in concert with business and/or mission stakeholders and tie work packages to milestones.
*   Work with OIS Release Train Engineer (RTE) and Scrum Master to gather, track, and incorporate into required documentation Agile team metrics from OIS’s work management tool, GitLab Ultimate.

Minimum Qualifications:

*   **Must have DOD Secret level clearance to start; U.S. Citizen required only for Federal Clearance Requirement**
*   Bachelor’s degree and at least 10 years’ experience; without a degree 4 additional years of experience would be required
*   4+ years of experience as a Product Owner and/or Project Manager using SCRUM/KANBAN frameworks that follow agile principles, values, and practices, preferably within a SAFe organization
*   4+ years of experience leading and supporting technical teams in cloud‑centric environments, including hands‑on work with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, and the integration of these capabilities within Agile software development teams.
*   Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple projects within a collaborative team environment
*   Demonstrates flexibility and willingness to do what it takes to get the job done
*   Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively both verbally and writing.
*   Must be a self-starter, strong leader, and have the ability to work independently with little supervision.

Desired Qualifications:

*   Desired Certifications: Security+; Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification and/or DAU Level III Project Management certification; Product Owner certification
*   Navy IT Program experience
*   Logistics experience, preferably DoD
*   Experience managing large scale software development projects

About Us:

Founded in 2010 and recently acquired by ERT in early 2026, Sev1Tech, an ERT Company provides IT, engineering, and program management solutions delivery to critical missions across Federal and Commercial Clients. With its acquisition by ERT, Sev1Tech expanded its ability to offer secure, mission-aligned digital solutions to support modernization, resilience and operational effectiveness for government customers operating in highly regulated mission environments. ERT and Sev1Tech together become a fully diversified engineering and federal technology solutions firm with broad reach into space, civilian, and defense markets.

  
Please apply directly at: https://careers-sev1tech.icims.com. For questions or to submit a referral, please contact: recruiting@sev1tech.com

_  
Sev1Tech is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status._

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

The Product Owner will be part of a broader platform experience team, responsible for Renaissance Intelligence – and education intelligence system that unifies assessment, instruction, and practice. This role is responsible for prioritizing and delivering a backlog of product features. As a member of this team, you'll be at the center of product innovation and development. You'll collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and your teammates to take ideas from concept to reality, utilizing your full range of skills and a healthy dose of user empathy.

title: IT Asset Management Specialist
description:
## **Summary**

This position is located in the IT Asset Management Division, IT Risk Management Directorate, Office of the Chief Information Officer.

The position description number for this position is 464536.

The salary range indicated reflects the locality pay adjustment for the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan area.

This is a non-supervisory, bargaining unit position.

Relocation expenses will not be authorized for the person(s) selected under this vacancy announcement.

  

## **This job is open to**

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

Anyone may apply - By law, employment at most U.S. Government agencies, including the Library of Congress, is limited to U.S. citizens. However, non-citizens may be hired, provided that other legal requirements are met and the Library determines there are no qualified U.S. citizens available for the position.

  

## **Duties**

**This permanent position is eligible for 100% distant telework/remote. The salary range advertised reflects salary for the Washington DC Locality Area. The actual salary range for candidates outside of the Washington DC Locality Area may differ.**

The incumbent supports the Library’s IT asset management program. As such, the incumbent is responsible for performing centralized IT asset management functions, processes, and solutions. Moreover, the incumbent is responsible for maintaining integration among IT asset management functions and other related processes and solutions.

Develops and enhances processes and automation for IT asset life cycle management. Ensures IT asset management processes are conducted in line with agency policies and standards. Working with stakeholders, identifies current and future IT asset needs, formulating plans and recommending actions to optimize the IT asset portfolio. Advises project, program, infrastructure and application portfolio managers on software licensing and compliance. Develops, implements, and manages production of IT asset life cycle management status reporting, metrics, and benchmarks.

Designs, develops and administers information technology systems and tools in a specific specialty area to meet complex new or modified current or future business requirements. Monitors the performance of these systems, adding enhancements, modifications, and additional features as requested by management and end users. Serves as an expert on IT asset management tools.

Evaluates and analyzes existing processes and automated solutions for continued effectiveness in meeting business and technology needs. Identifies deficiencies in existing process and automated solution design and recommends improvements. Analyzes process and automated solution performance, efficiency, stability, interoperability, portability, security, and scalability, and implements improvements. Reviews data submissions and automatically collected data to identify discrepancies and works with submitters and stakeholders to effect corrections.

Manages and coordinates contract administration activities for long-term, extensive technical service contracts. Independently evaluates contractor procedures for the analysis, design, development, test, and support of IT systems. Directs the installation and maintenance of computer hardware and software supplied by the equipment manufacturers or software development companies.

  

## **Requirements**

### **Conditions of employment**

**Conditions of Employment**

### **Qualifications**

Knowledge of IT asset management (ITAM) practices.\*\*

Ability to identify and analyze metrics.

Ability to create guidelines and requirements.

Ability to perform quality assurance.

This job does not have an education qualification requirement.

Although it is the Library's policy to afford the maximum pay benefit to employees when setting rates of pay, a new appointee who has had no previous Federal service will generally be paid at step one of the grade.

The proof or disability/certification may be issued by the State Vocational Rehabilitation Office, Disability Services or Career Services office of the applicant’s college or university, or the Department of Veterans Affairs. The letter must verify that the applicant has a severe disability and must be dated within three years of the date of the application. Certification from health care providers are not accepted. The Library reserves the right to fill a lesser or greater number of vacancies indicated during the life of this vacancy announcement.

Initial permanent appointments to the Library of Congress require completion of a one-year probationary period. Probationary periods served at other Federal agencies do not count toward this requirement.

However, not all service units within the Library of Congress participates in the repayment of federally insured student loans. Therefore, determination to repay a federally insured student loan is subject to approval by the appropriate service unit.

Those applying for 5-point preference must submit Member Copy 4 of your DD 214. title: Data Analyst
description:
**Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media**

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online **marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands**. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven **matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.** They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

*   The direct measurability of digital media.
*   Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
*   The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel.

**  
Job Category**

As a key member of the Client Analytics team, you will be responsible for data-driven insights that enable QuinStreet's Marketing and Media teams to maximize profitability while developing customer relationships. You will gather, organize, and aggregate complex sets of data in order to produce meaningful business insight in areas such as ad network optimization, ad merchandising, marketing performance, quality monitoring, partner development, product testing, and more. You will also communicate your insights and findings to various members of our Client, Media, Analytics, and Executive teams.

  

**Responsibilities**

*   Leverage your analytical abilities to develop custom reports and marketing strategies.
*   Work closely with client managers to identify opportunities to optimize client campaigns and expand budgets.
*   Actively mine data from databases to develop business and predictive models using various statistical techniques.
*   Build complex and multi-layered forecasts in Excel and Tableau for business planning.
*   Support ongoing analysis and monitoring of key business KPIs.
*   Key liaison between business and technical resources in managing day to day data analytics.
*   Ensure data quality of external partners used to help drive decisions

  

**Experience**

*   Record of high academic achievement with a BS degree in Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Math/Science, or otherwise proven background in business/analytics. MS preferred.
*   2+ years of work experience in data analytics/science.
*   Strong analytical mindset with a drive toward actionable insights from data.
*   Deep interest in online marketing and media industry. Industry experience a plus.
*   High internal motivation with ability to understand the full stack of product development.
*   Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to apply the most efficient analytical tool for the business problem.
*   Willingness to initiate and own research, exploration, and analysis from start to finish for any business problem.
*   Good interpersonal skills and ability to remain focused-yet-flexible in a fast-paced internet company environment.
*   Proficiency in MS Excel, strong SQL, and working knowledge of or familiarity with database applications. (e.g., Python, R and Tableau)

The expected salary range for this position is $85,000 USD to $100,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company's compensation practices. The salary may be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location. The position is also eligible to receive performance bonus or commission and equity in the form of restricted stock units. This position is eligible to participate in the Company's standard employee benefits programs, which currently include health care benefits; (2) retirement benefits; (3) the amount of paid days off (paid sick leave, parental leave, paid time off, or vacation benefits); (4) any other tax-reportable benefits.

#LI-REMOTE

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Solution Architect - Infrastructure Presales
description:
The Senior Solution Architect is an important member of our Pre-Sales team and works directly with customers, assist account managers in sales calls and business development, recommend business and technical solutions, and create statements of work. This is a customer-facing role with opportunities to shape the way we engage clients, deliver projects, and adopt new technologies. We work collaboratively as a team to deliver exceptional enterprise solutions and believe attention to detail and a consultative experience is integral to our success. The Solutions Architect will be responsible for (but not limited to) creating architectural designs, infrastructure/connectivity analysis and design, leading onsite (or virtual) workshops and discovery & design sessions, writing documentation, and creating project estimates.

### **Responsibilities**

*   Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales engagements for NRI North America's Hybrid Infrastructure practice.
*   Collaborate with account executives to understand client requirements and develop tailored infrastructure solutions.
*   Design and present end-to-end solutions across hybrid cloud, data center, storage, networking, and security domains.
*   Lead client-facing workshops, discovery sessions, and whiteboarding engagements—onsite or virtual—to capture technical requirements and propose scalable architectures.
*   Create detailed Statements of Work (SOWs), technical documentation, bill of materials, and high-level designs.
*   Advise clients on Cisco enterprise networking solutions, including routing/switching, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security architectures.
*   Act as a trusted advisor to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment between business goals and technology outcomes.
*   Support internal solution engineering and delivery teams during project handoff and implementation planning.
*   Stay current on emerging technologies, Cisco certifications, and best practices relevant to enterprise networking and hybrid infrastructure.
*   Participate in internal knowledge sharing, mentoring, and the development of reusable solution frameworks and templates.
*   Build and maintain strong relationships with Cisco, other technology partners, and key client stakeholders.
*   Assist in RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, and architectural reviews as part of the sales lifecycle.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

*   Deep experience designing and architecting complex, cross-domain IT solutions across hybrid cloud, data center, storage, networking, data protection, and infrastructure modernization technologies at enterprise clients.
*   Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with **Cisco enterprise networking**, including LAN/WAN architecture, SD-WAN, routing and switching, wireless, network security, and network segmentation best practices.
*   Ability to develop scalable, secure, and high-performing network designs aligned to client needs and industry best practices.
*   **CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional)** certification is highly desired.
*   **CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert)** certification is a strong plus and will be given special consideration.
*   Proven ability to support pre-sales efforts by conducting technical discovery sessions, developing solution strategies, preparing SOWs, and presenting to executive and technical stakeholders.
*   Experience leading and participating in client-facing engagements, including whiteboard sessions, technical deep-dives, and product demonstrations.
*   Comfortable working with internal solution teams, sales leadership, partner ecosystems, and external vendors to shape and deliver client outcomes.
*   Experience guiding enterprise customers through complex solution evaluations and network transformation initiatives.
*   Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to simplify complex technical topics for business and executive audiences.
*   A consultative and strategic mindset with the ability to act as a trusted advisor and long-term partner to clients.
*   Minimum of 10 years in a solution architecture, network engineering, or technical pre-sales role with a focus on enterprise infrastructure.

### **Benefits - You'll love working at NRI not just for the usual benefits, but for our environment and culture!**

*   You'll work with a great group of people in a highly collaborative team and results oriented atmosphere
*   You'll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and extremely positive environment where there is always the opportunity to challenge your skills and really move the needle
*   You’ll work with large, sophisticated, and progressive clients throughout North America
*   We provide a comprehensive benefits program including: **$0 Healthcare option, company contribution to Health Savings Account with enrollment in a qualifying plan, 401(k) plus company match, Professional Development funds, Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus 11 company holidays, 4 weeks Parental/Caregiver Leave, company paid family building/fertility benefits through Progyny, Dental and Vision Insurance, and company paid Life/AD&D, short term and long term disability insurance.**

$165,000 - $185,000 a year

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary bonus plan based on company and individual performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each candidate, including experience and location.

description:
**Description**

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

**Job Summary**

The Principal Solution Architect – Hybrid Infrastructure is a field-based technical pre-sales role that focuses on developing comprehensive Hybrid Infrastructure solutions for CDW's Education customers. This role involves providing consultative guidance, supporting partner product sales, scoping service offerings, and fostering strategic relationships to drive business growth. In this role you will be working with customers, delivery, and internal sales teams to develop and maintain strategic relationships and be a trusted advisor to grow our Hybrid Infrastructure services business.

**What you will do**

*   Develop appropriate assessment and service solutions for CDW customers, including architecture, optimizations, technology health checks, deployment services, and advisory services.
*   Collaborate with customers, delivery teams, and internal sales to offer consultative guidance, plan sales strategy, and author statements of work (SOWs).
*   Analyze technical and competitive considerations, defining actions to meet customer expectations in the sales cycle by uncovering customer long-term goals and requirements and crafting solutions that build towards the desired end goals.
*   Maintain strategic relationships with Customers, Internal Sales & Delivery management, acting as a trusted advisor to drive business growth.

*   Drive outreach initiatives, technical enablement projects, coaching, and mentoring for other SAs, Solution Executives, and Field Sellers.

*   Minimum of (8) years in technical, pre-sales, or post-sale delivery role.
*   Experience designing and architecting Hybrid Infrastructure tailored to CDW’s client needs.
*   Experience designing and architecting Datacenter and Hybrid solutions tailored to CDW’s client needs.

*   The candidate should have the ability to design and communicate comprehensive solutions that address customer requirements, business challenges, and build consensus around the final solution.
*   They should be skilled in analyzing complex problems, identifying appropriate solutions, and translating technical concepts into understandable terms for customers.
